name: Overseer Krex-9
ability_1_desc: All opponent's figures within 3 clear sight spaces of Overseer Krex-9 subtract 1 from their Attack Value when attacking with a normal attack. An Attack Value cannot be reduced below 1.
ability_2_desc: When rolling defense dice against a special attack, Overseer Krex-9 adds 2 dice.
design_note: Seven life on a Range 5 attacker with a debuff aura is premium, but the aura only works at short range where a shooter does not want to stand.

name: Overseer Krex-9 (variant)
ability_1_desc: All opponent's figures within 3 clear sight spaces of Overseer Krex-9 subtract 1 from their Attack Value when attacking with a normal attack. An Attack Value cannot be reduced below 1.
ability_2_desc: When rolling defense dice against a special attack, Overseer Krex-9 adds 2 dice.
ability_3_desc: After revealing an Order Marker on this card and before taking a turn with Overseer Krex-9, roll the 20-sided die. If you roll a 15 or higher, choose an opponent. That opponent immediately takes this turn with Overseer Krex-9, moving him and attacking with him as if Overseer Krex-9 were his or her own figure. At the end of that turn, you again control Overseer Krex-9.
design_note: A 30% chance per Order Marker that the opponent fires your best gun at your own army is worse than simply losing the turn, and the risk compounds with every marker committed.

name: Ythara The Sunblade
ability_1_desc: Range 1. Attack 2. Ythara the Sunblade attacks all figures adjacent to her, friend or foe. Roll attack dice once for all affected figures. Each figure rolls defense dice separately.
ability_2_desc: Ythara the Sunblade is never attacked when leaving an engagement, and she does not have to stop her movement when entering or leaving a space adjacent to an opponent's figure.
design_note: Attack 5 and Defense 5 on a hero who can disengage freely is very efficient, while the multi-target special attack is a situational upgrade that can also clip friendlies.

name: Ythara The Sunblade (variant)
ability_1_desc: Range 1. Attack 2. Ythara the Sunblade attacks all figures adjacent to her, friend or foe. Roll attack dice once for all affected figures. Each figure rolls defense dice separately.
ability_2_desc: Ythara the Sunblade is never attacked when leaving an engagement, and she does not have to stop her movement when entering or leaving a space adjacent to an opponent's figure.
ability_3_desc: When you take a turn with Ythara the Sunblade, she must attack the figure nearest to her, friend or foe, if she is able to attack any figure. If two or more figures are the same distance from Ythara the Sunblade, you may choose which of those figures she attacks. Ythara the Sunblade must move as far as possible toward the nearest figure before attacking.
ability_4_desc: Ythara the Sunblade is never attacked when leaving an engagement, and she does not have to stop her movement when entering or leaving a space adjacent to an opponent's figure.
design_note: Forced targeting of the nearest figure makes her stats nearly unusable alongside your own army yet still lethal as a lone skirmisher, so her price depends on how isolated a player is willing to keep her.

name: Dame Corvyn Thrale
ability_1_desc: All Knights you control within 4 clear sight spaces of Dame Corvyn Thrale add 1 to their Attack Value when attacking an adjacent figure.
ability_2_desc: After moving and before attacking with Dame Corvyn Thrale, you may choose one adjacent Small or Medium figure and roll the 20-sided die. If you roll a 15 or higher, the chosen figure receives one wound. A figure may be affected by Warhorse Trample 15 only once per turn.
design_note: A strong melee statline paired with a cheap-but-real squad aura and a 30% chance free wound, which makes her baseline hard to separate from Alastair MacDirk's tier.

name: Dame Corvyn Thrale (variant)
ability_1_desc: All Knights you control within 4 clear sight spaces of Dame Corvyn Thrale add 1 to their Attack Value when attacking an adjacent figure.
ability_2_desc: After moving and before attacking with Dame Corvyn Thrale, you may choose one adjacent Small or Medium figure and roll the 20-sided die. If you roll a 15 or higher, the chosen figure receives one wound. A figure may be affected by Warhorse Trample 15 only once per turn.
ability_3_desc: Dame Corvyn Thrale cannot move and attack on the same turn. If she moves one or more spaces on her turn, she cannot attack this turn. If she attacks on her turn, she cannot move this turn.
design_note: The drawback gutting her Attack 5 also partially strands Warhorse Trample, so the discount must account for two powers losing value at once while the aura is untouched.

name: Grull Bonecleaver
ability_1_desc: When Grull Bonecleaver attacks a figure with a Defense Value of 4 or higher, add 1 to Grull Bonecleaver's Attack Value.
ability_2_desc: After taking a turn with Grull Bonecleaver, roll the 20-sided die. If you roll a 13 or higher, you may immediately take a turn with any one Orc Squad you control. You may not use Orc Warband Frenzy more than once per turn.
design_note: A 40% chance of a free squad turn is quasi-bonding whose value swings wildly depending on whether the drafter owns Orc squads.

name: Grull Bonecleaver (variant)
ability_1_desc: When Grull Bonecleaver attacks a figure with a Defense Value of 4 or higher, add 1 to Grull Bonecleaver's Attack Value.
ability_2_desc: After taking a turn with Grull Bonecleaver, roll the 20-sided die. If you roll a 13 or higher, you may immediately take a turn with any one Orc Squad you control. You may not use Orc Warband Frenzy more than once per turn.
ability_3_desc: When Grull Bonecleaver attacks, he must attack the figure closest to him, friend or foe. Count the minimum number of spaces from Grull Bonecleaver to each figure within his range and clear sight. If two or more figures are equally close, your opponent chooses which of those figures Grull Bonecleaver must attack.
design_note: Forced targeting is nearly harmless when he is played alone at the front but catastrophic in the Orc swarm army his own bonding-style power wants him to lead.

name: Sylthanne Moonwake
ability_1_desc: Range 7. Attack 3. When a figure is attacked with Piercing Arrow Special Attack, that figure cannot roll more than 2 defense dice, and it receives no defensive bonuses from Glyphs.
ability_2_desc: When Sylthanne Moonwake rolls defense dice against an attacking figure who is 4 or more spaces away, add 2 to her Defense Value.
design_note: A Range 6 Attack 4 hero who also carries an armor-ignoring Range 7 special attack blurs the line between a support archer and a 150-point sniper.

name: Sylthanne Moonwake (variant)
ability_1_desc: Range 7. Attack 3. When a figure is attacked with Piercing Arrow Special Attack, that figure cannot roll more than 2 defense dice, and it receives no defensive bonuses from Glyphs.
ability_2_desc: When Sylthanne Moonwake rolls defense dice against an attacking figure who is 4 or more spaces away, add 2 to her Defense Value.
ability_3_desc: At the end of each round, after the last Order Marker has been revealed and that turn is finished, place one Wound Marker on this Army Card. If Sylthanne Moonwake receives her last wound from Waning Curse, she is destroyed.
design_note: A guaranteed wound per round converts her 5 life into a hard five-round clock, so her price depends almost entirely on how much damage a ranged hero can output before expiring.

name: Enforcer Vox-14
ability_1_desc: Range 5. Attack 2. Choose a figure to attack. All figures adjacent to the chosen figure are also affected by Suppression Burst Special Attack. Roll attack dice once for all affected figures. Each affected figure rolls defense dice separately.
ability_2_desc: When Enforcer Vox-14 rolls defense dice against a Special Attack, add 2 dice to his defense roll.
design_note: An area special attack plus anti-special-attack armor gives it strong matchup-dependent value that is easy to overprice against melee-heavy armies.

name: Enforcer Vox-14 (variant)
ability_1_desc: Range 5. Attack 2. Choose a figure to attack. All figures adjacent to the chosen figure are also affected by Suppression Burst Special Attack. Roll attack dice once for all affected figures. Each affected figure rolls defense dice separately.
ability_2_desc: When Enforcer Vox-14 rolls defense dice against a Special Attack, add 2 dice to his defense roll.
ability_3_desc: After revealing an Order Marker on this Army Card and before taking a turn with Enforcer Vox-14, roll the 20-sided die. If you roll a 15 or higher, an opponent takes this turn with Enforcer Vox-14 instead of you, moving and attacking with him as if he were their own figure. If there is more than one opponent, the opponent to your left takes the turn. The revealed Order Marker is removed as normal.
design_note: A 30% chance per activated turn of handing an Attack 4 area-blaster to the enemy is a swing drawback whose cost is far worse than simply losing the turn.

name: Verrick Stormhelm
ability_1_desc: When rolling defense dice against a normal attack from an adjacent attacking figure, if Verrick Stormhelm rolls 3 or more shields, the attacking figure receives 1 wound.
ability_2_desc: All Knights and Soldiers you control who follow Jandar and are within 4 clear sight spaces of Verrick Stormhelm add 1 to their Defense Value.
design_note: A defensive aura plus a shields-based counterattack on an already durable 6-life, 5-attack chassis makes the baseline hard to anchor before the drawback twin is compared.

name: Verrick Stormhelm (variant)
ability_1_desc: When rolling defense dice against a normal attack from an adjacent attacking figure, if Verrick Stormhelm (variant) rolls 3 or more shields, the attacking figure receives 1 wound.
ability_2_desc: All Knights and Soldiers you control who follow Jandar and are within 4 clear sight spaces of Verrick Stormhelm (variant) add 1 to their Defense Value.
ability_3_desc: At the end of every round, after all Order Markers have been revealed, Verrick Stormhelm (variant) receives 1 wound. This wound cannot be prevented or ignored by any special power.
design_note: A guaranteed wound each round caps his effective lifespan at six rounds regardless of defense, so his aura value must be weighed against a hard expiration date.

name: Nazhira Wingbreaker
ability_1_desc: When counting spaces for Nazhira Wingbreaker's movement, ignore elevations. Nazhira may fly over water without stopping, pass over figures without becoming engaged, and fly over obstacles such as ruins. When Nazhira starts to fly, if she is engaged, she will take any leaving engagement attacks.
ability_2_desc: If Nazhira Wingbreaker moved 4 or more spaces this turn, and she is attacking an adjacent figure whose level is lower than her own, add 2 dice to her attack.
design_note: Flying plus a conditional +2 attack dive makes her burst damage far higher than her printed 5 attack suggests, while her 3 defense keeps her fragile.

name: Nazhira Wingbreaker (variant)
ability_1_desc: When counting spaces for Nazhira Wingbreaker (variant)'s movement, ignore elevations. Nazhira may fly over water without stopping, pass over figures without becoming engaged, and fly over obstacles such as ruins. When Nazhira starts to fly, if she is engaged, she will take any leaving engagement attacks.
ability_2_desc: If Nazhira Wingbreaker (variant) moved 4 or more spaces this turn, and she is attacking an adjacent figure whose level is lower than her own, add 2 dice to her attack.
ability_3_desc: Nazhira Wingbreaker (variant) cannot move and attack on the same turn. If you move Nazhira (variant) any number of spaces, her turn ends immediately after her movement and she cannot attack.
design_note: The drawback directly cancels her own Diving Assault requirement, so the added power is worse than a generic no-move-and-attack restriction and the twin's gap should be unusually wide.

name: Thrandig Emberfist
ability_1_desc: After attacking with Thrandig Emberfist, if the defending figure was destroyed, you may move Thrandig Emberfist up to 3 spaces and attack one additional time. Thrandig Emberfist cannot use Emberfist Onslaught more than twice on the same turn.
ability_2_desc: When rolling defense dice for Thrandig Emberfist, if he is on a lava, lava field, rock, or road space, add 1 automatic shield to the defense roll.
design_note: Chain-cleaving through squads with a 5-attack, 7-life brawler scales enormously against common armies while barely mattering against a two-Hero army.

name: Thrandig Emberfist (variant)
ability_1_desc: After attacking with Thrandig Emberfist (variant), if the defending figure was destroyed, you may move Thrandig Emberfist (variant) up to 3 spaces and attack one additional time. Thrandig Emberfist (variant) cannot use Emberfist Onslaught more than twice on the same turn.
ability_2_desc: When rolling defense dice for Thrandig Emberfist (variant), if he is on a lava, lava field, rock, or road space, add 1 automatic shield to the defense roll.
ability_3_desc: When you take a turn with Thrandig Emberfist (variant), he must move the shortest possible path toward the figure nearest to him, friend or foe, and he must attack that figure if he is adjacent to it at the end of his movement. If two or more figures are equally near, you choose which of those figures Thrandig (variant) must move toward and attack. Thrandig Emberfist (variant) may never attack a figure other than the nearest figure.
ability_4_desc: After taking a turn with Thrandig Emberfist (variant), you may remove 1 wound marker from this Army Card.
design_note: Forced friendly fire plus forced pathing gut his tactical use, but the added self-healing and his chain-attack power can occasionally combine with the drawback to mow through your own squads for extra swings.

name: Sir Ovanden the Bulwark
ability_1_desc: All small or medium figures you control adjacent to Sir Ovanden the Bulwark add 1 to their defense dice when rolling defense against a normal attack.
ability_2_desc: When attacking with Sir Ovanden the Bulwark, add 1 die to his attack for every 2 Wound Markers on this Army Card, to a maximum of 2 additional attack dice.
ability_3_desc: Sir Ovanden the Bulwark may not be moved or placed by any opponent's special power, and he does not take leaving engagement attacks from figures with 3 or fewer life.
design_note: Seven life with a wound-fueled attack bonus means wounds are simultaneously a liability and an asset, muddying the usual life-to-points curve.

name: Sir Ovanden the Bulwark (variant)
ability_1_desc: All small or medium figures you control adjacent to Sir Ovanden the Bulwark (variant) add 1 to their defense dice when rolling defense against a normal attack.
ability_2_desc: When attacking with Sir Ovanden the Bulwark (variant), add 1 die to his attack for every 2 Wound Markers on this Army Card, to a maximum of 2 additional attack dice.
ability_3_desc: Sir Ovanden the Bulwark (variant) may not be moved or placed by any opponent's special power, and he does not take leaving engagement attacks from figures with 3 or fewer life.
ability_4_desc: Wound Markers may never be removed from this Army Card by any special power or by any glyph.
design_note: Being unhealable matters only in armies that brought healing, and it even locks in the card's own wound-based attack bonus, so the penalty is narrow but real.

name: Stonevow Shieldbearers
ability_1_desc: Before taking a turn with Stonevow Shieldbearers, you may first take a turn with a Unique Hero you control who is a Dwarf Warlord.
ability_2_desc: When rolling defense dice against a normal attack, a Stonevow Shieldbearer adds 1 automatic shield to whatever is rolled if it is adjacent to at least one other Stonevow Shieldbearer you control.
ability_3_desc: If a Stonevow Shieldbearer does not move on its turn, it may add 1 die to its attack and it may attack an opponent's figure that is up to 2 spaces away, as long as no figure occupies the space between them.
design_note: A slow 3-figure unique squad with bonding, an automatic shield, and a stand-still reach attack can price like a ranged squad despite melee range.

name: Stonevow Shieldbearers (variant)
ability_1_desc: Before taking a turn with Stonevow Shieldbearers (variant), you may first take a turn with a Unique Hero you control who is a Dwarf Warlord.
ability_2_desc: When rolling defense dice against a normal attack, a Stonevow Shieldbearer (variant) adds 1 automatic shield to whatever is rolled if it is adjacent to at least one other Stonevow Shieldbearer (variant) you control.
ability_3_desc: If a Stonevow Shieldbearer (variant) does not move on its turn, it may add 1 die to its attack and it may attack an opponent's figure that is up to 2 spaces away, as long as no figure occupies the space between them.
ability_4_desc: When rolling defense dice for a Stonevow Shieldbearer (variant) that is engaged with 2 or more opponent's figures, subtract 1 defense die.
design_note: The -1 defense trigger fires exactly when the squad is being swarmed, which is also when its automatic shield is most valuable, so the drawback bites harder than it reads.

name: Nyxaril the Duskwing
ability_1_desc: Range 5. Attack 2. Choose a figure to attack. You may attack 1 additional time with Squall Bolt Special Attack, but you must target a different figure with the second attack.
ability_2_desc: After moving and before attacking with Nyxaril the Duskwing, you may choose one small or medium figure adjacent to Nyxaril and roll the 20-sided die. If you roll a 15 or higher, move that chosen figure up to 3 spaces. The chosen figure takes any falling damage normally. Gale Push cannot be used to move a figure onto a space it could not normally occupy.
ability_3_desc: When counting spaces for Nyxaril the Duskwing's movement, ignore elevations. Nyxaril may fly over water without stopping, pass over figures without becoming engaged, and fly over obstacles such as ruins. When Nyxaril starts to fly, if he is engaged he will not take any leaving engagement attacks.
design_note: A cheap two-target special attack paired with stealth flying and a soft-control d20 power makes the mobility premium hard to separate from the offensive value.

name: Nyxaril the Duskwing (variant)
ability_1_desc: Range 5. Attack 2. Choose a figure to attack. You may attack 1 additional time with Squall Bolt Special Attack, but you must target a different figure with the second attack.
ability_2_desc: After moving and before attacking with Nyxaril the Duskwing, you may choose one small or medium figure adjacent to Nyxaril and roll the 20-sided die. If you roll a 15 or higher, move that chosen figure up to 3 spaces. The chosen figure takes any falling damage normally. Gale Push cannot be used to move a figure onto a space it could not normally occupy.
ability_3_desc: When counting spaces for Nyxaril the Duskwing's movement, ignore elevations. Nyxaril may fly over water without stopping, pass over figures without becoming engaged, and fly over obstacles such as ruins. When Nyxaril starts to fly, if he is engaged he will not take any leaving engagement attacks.
ability_4_desc: If there are one or more Wound Markers on this Army Card, Nyxaril the Duskwing loses his Stealth Flying special power. If Nyxaril is on a space he could not normally occupy when he loses Stealth Flying, immediately place him on the nearest empty space of the same level or lower, and he takes any falling damage normally.
design_note: The drawback only bites after the first wound, so it discounts survivability and late-game mobility without touching his opening turns.

name: Molokh Pit Brutes
ability_1_desc: A Molokh Pit Brute rolls 1 additional attack die when attacking an opponent's figure that is engaged with another Molokh Pit Brute you control.
ability_2_desc: After taking a turn with the Molokh Pit Brutes, if a Molokh Pit Brute you control destroyed an opponent's figure this turn, roll the 20-sided die. If you roll a 16 or higher, you may take another turn with the Molokh Pit Brutes.
design_note: Its attack bonus and extra-turn chance both require successful clumping, so the card's real output swings wildly with board position.

name: Molokh Pit Brutes (variant)
ability_1_desc: A Molokh Pit Brute rolls 1 additional attack die when attacking an opponent's figure that is engaged with another Molokh Pit Brute you control.
ability_2_desc: After taking a turn with the Molokh Pit Brutes, if a Molokh Pit Brute you control destroyed an opponent's figure this turn, roll the 20-sided die. If you roll a 16 or higher, you may take another turn with the Molokh Pit Brutes.
ability_3_desc: Molokh Pit Brutes cannot pick up, carry, or be affected by any glyph. A Molokh Pit Brute may end its movement on a glyph space, but treat that space as a normal space for the Molokh Pit Brute.
design_note: Glyph denial costs nothing on some maps and a full power glyph on others, making the discount map-dependent.

name: Wardens of Thaelen Reach
ability_1_desc: If a Warden of Thaelen Reach you control did not move this turn, that Warden rolls 1 additional attack die when attacking a non-adjacent figure.
ability_2_desc: All Unique Human Heroes you control who are adjacent to a Warden of Thaelen Reach add 1 to their Defense Value.
design_note: A range 6, attack 3 squad that can reach attack 4 while stationary sits right at the top of the ranged-squad band, and the hero-guard aura value depends entirely on the army built around it.

name: Wardens of Thaelen Reach (variant)
ability_1_desc: If a Warden of Thaelen Reach you control did not move this turn, that Warden rolls 1 additional attack die when attacking a non-adjacent figure.
ability_2_desc: All Unique Human Heroes you control who are adjacent to a Warden of Thaelen Reach add 1 to their Defense Value.
ability_3_desc: When you move a Warden of Thaelen Reach, that Warden must end its movement adjacent to another friendly figure, if possible. If a Warden cannot end its movement adjacent to another friendly figure, it may move normally.
design_note: Forced clumping makes the squad easier to hit with area special attacks while barely restricting a squad that already wants to hold a firing line.

name: Torgast the Kilnborn
ability_1_desc: Range 1. Attack 3. All figures adjacent to Torgast the Kilnborn are affected by Molten Sweep Special Attack. Roll attack dice once for all affected figures. Figures on molten lava spaces roll 1 less defense die against Molten Sweep Special Attack.
ability_2_desc: All friendly Moltarn figures adjacent to Torgast the Kilnborn roll 1 additional attack die and 1 additional defense die.
ability_3_desc: Torgast the Kilnborn never rolls for molten lava damage or lava field damage, and he does not have to stop on molten lava spaces.
design_note: Strong base stats plus a crowd-clearing special attack and a squad-buff aura stack into an unclear premium over a plain melee beatstick.

name: Torgast the Kilnborn (variant)
ability_1_desc: Range 1. Attack 3. All figures adjacent to Torgast the Kilnborn are affected by Molten Sweep Special Attack. Roll attack dice once for all affected figures. Figures on molten lava spaces roll 1 less defense die against Molten Sweep Special Attack.
ability_2_desc: All friendly Moltarn figures adjacent to Torgast the Kilnborn roll 1 additional attack die and 1 additional defense die.
ability_3_desc: Torgast the Kilnborn never rolls for molten lava damage or lava field damage, and he does not have to stop on molten lava spaces.
ability_4_desc: You may never remove a Wound Marker from this Army Card for any reason. Torgast the Kilnborn cannot be healed by any special power or glyph.
design_note: Immunity to healing is worth nothing in most armies and a large loss in a healer-heavy build, so the discount hinges on assumed metagame support.

name: Seraphine Dawncaller
ability_1_desc: When counting spaces for Seraphine Dawncaller's movement, ignore elevations. Seraphine may fly over water without stopping, pass over figures without becoming engaged, and fly over obstacles such as ruins. When Seraphine starts to fly, if she is engaged she will take any leaving engagement attacks.
ability_2_desc: All friendly Unique Heroes adjacent to Seraphine Dawncaller add 1 to their Defense Value.
ability_3_desc: After moving and before attacking with Seraphine Dawncaller, you may choose an adjacent figure and roll the 20-sided die. If Seraphine is on a higher elevation than the chosen figure, add 2 to your roll. If you roll a 15 or higher, the chosen figure receives 1 wound.
design_note: A flying aura-hero whose defense buff, d20 chip damage, and mobility all stack, making the baseline hard to separate from its drawback twin.

name: Seraphine Dawncaller (variant)
ability_1_desc: When counting spaces for Seraphine Dawncaller's movement, ignore elevations. Seraphine may fly over water without stopping, pass over figures without becoming engaged, and fly over obstacles such as ruins. When Seraphine starts to fly, if she is engaged she will take any leaving engagement attacks.
ability_2_desc: All friendly Unique Heroes adjacent to Seraphine Dawncaller add 1 to their Defense Value.
ability_3_desc: After moving and before attacking with Seraphine Dawncaller, you may choose an adjacent figure and roll the 20-sided die. If Seraphine is on a higher elevation than the chosen figure, add 2 to your roll. If you roll a 15 or higher, the chosen figure receives 1 wound.
ability_4_desc: While there are one or more Wound Markers on this Army Card, Seraphine Dawncaller cannot use her Flying special power.
design_note: The drawback costs nothing until the first wound lands but then strips the single most valuable movement power, so its discount depends entirely on how often she is hit.

name: Maluk the Rotbound
ability_1_desc: After Maluk the Rotbound inflicts one or more wounds on an opponent's figure with a normal attack, roll the 20-sided die. If you roll a 13 or higher, remove 1 Wound Marker from this Army Card or from any friendly Undead Hero within 4 clear sight spaces of Maluk.
ability_2_desc: After revealing an Order Marker on Maluk the Rotbound and before taking his turn, you may choose up to 2 Undead Squad figures you control within 6 clear sight spaces of Maluk and move each of them up to 3 spaces. They may not attack.
ability_3_desc: Opponent's figures adjacent to Maluk the Rotbound subtract 1 from their Move Value.
design_note: Self-sustain plus a free squad-repositioning order-marker trick on a ranged hero blurs the line between a 90-point support piece and a 130-point engine.

name: Maluk the Rotbound (variant)
ability_1_desc: After Maluk the Rotbound inflicts one or more wounds on an opponent's figure with a normal attack, roll the 20-sided die. If you roll a 13 or higher, remove 1 Wound Marker from this Army Card or from any friendly Undead Hero within 4 clear sight spaces of Maluk.
ability_2_desc: After revealing an Order Marker on Maluk the Rotbound and before taking his turn, you may choose up to 2 Undead Squad figures you control within 6 clear sight spaces of Maluk and move each of them up to 3 spaces. They may not attack.
ability_3_desc: Opponent's figures adjacent to Maluk the Rotbound subtract 1 from their Move Value.
ability_4_desc: Wound Markers can never be removed from this Army Card by any special power, glyph, or other game effect.
design_note: The drawback partially cancels one of his own printed powers, so the discount must account for a lost ability rather than just a lost option.

name: Ashfen Lancers
ability_1_desc: Range 1. Attack 4. An Ashfen Lancer may only use the Lance Charge Special Attack if it moved at least 3 spaces this turn. Figures attacked with the Lance Charge Special Attack roll 1 fewer defense die.
ability_2_desc: Ashfen Lancers are never attacked when leaving an engagement.
ability_3_desc: Before taking a turn with Ashfen Lancers, you may first take a turn with any Human Warlord you control.
design_note: A three-figure unique squad with a defense-piercing charge, free disengage, and warlord bonding sits awkwardly between a 90-point and a 130-point squad.

name: Ashfen Lancers (variant)
ability_1_desc: Range 1. Attack 4. An Ashfen Lancer may only use the Lance Charge Special Attack if it moved at least 3 spaces this turn. Figures attacked with the Lance Charge Special Attack roll 1 fewer defense die.
ability_2_desc: Ashfen Lancers are never attacked when leaving an engagement.
ability_3_desc: Before taking a turn with Ashfen Lancers, you may first take a turn with any Human Warlord you control.
ability_4_desc: When an Ashfen Lancer is engaged with 2 or more figures, subtract 1 from its Defense Value.
design_note: Against swarm armies the penalty is nearly permanent, but the squad's free disengage lets a careful player dodge it most turns, making the true discount small and matchup dependent.

name: Kalvar the Unbound
ability_1_desc: After moving with Kalvar the Unbound, Kalvar must attack a figure adjacent to him, even a figure you control. If two or more figures are adjacent to Kalvar, the opponent to your left chooses which figure Kalvar must attack. If no figure is adjacent to Kalvar after he moves, Kalvar does not attack this turn.
ability_2_desc: After taking a turn with Kalvar the Unbound, if Kalvar did not inflict at least one wound this turn, place one Wound Marker on this Army Card.
ability_3_desc: Kalvar the Unbound is never attacked when leaving an engagement.
design_note: Attack 6 with Move 6 is near-dragon offense, but opponent-chosen targeting that can force friendly fire plus a guaranteed self-wound on a whiffed turn makes his effective output and survivability wildly swingy.

name: Kiln Road Sappers
ability_1_desc: Range 1. Attack 5. Choose one adjacent figure to attack with Blasting Charge Special Attack. After this attack is resolved, destroy the attacking Kiln Road Sapper.
ability_2_desc: Before attacking with Blasting Charge Special Attack, roll the 20-sided die. If you roll a 1-4, destroy the attacking Kiln Road Sapper and do not roll attack dice. If you roll a 5 or higher, attack normally with Blasting Charge Special Attack.
ability_3_desc: Kiln Road Sappers are never attacked when leaving an engagement.
design_note: Each figure can convert itself into one Attack 5 melee strike, so the card is priced as three or four one-shot bombs with a 20% dud rate rather than as a normal melee squad.

name: Nyx Vantell, Ledger Thief
ability_1_desc: When Nyx Vantell attacks an adjacent enemy figure that is engaged with at least one other figure you control, add 3 to Nyx Vantell's Attack Value for that attack.
ability_2_desc: At the end of a round in which Nyx Vantell received one or more wounds, roll the 20-sided die. If you roll a 1-6, remove Nyx Vantell from the battlefield. Nyx Vantell is destroyed and counts as a destroyed Unique Hero for your opponents.
ability_3_desc: Nyx Vantell can move through all figures and is never attacked when leaving an engagement.
design_note: Attack 6 flanking strikes on a Move 7 infiltrator would be premium, but a 30% chance to simply vanish at the end of any round she is wounded means she often leaves the game before her second order marker resolves.

name: Sylwe Quickloose
ability_1_desc: Range 9. Attack 2. Choose a non-adjacent figure to attack. The chosen figure cannot roll defense dice against Whisperwind Shot Special Attack. Sylwe Quickloose may not use Whisperwind Shot Special Attack on two consecutive turns with Sylwe Quickloose.
ability_2_desc: After attacking with Whisperwind Shot Special Attack, roll the 20-sided die. If you roll a 1-6, you must remove one Order Marker from this Army Card without revealing it. If there are no Order Markers on this Army Card, nothing happens.
ability_3_desc: When rolling defense dice for Sylwe Quickloose against an attacking adjacent figure, subtract 2 defense dice.
ability_4_desc: Sylwe Quickloose never takes any leaving engagement attacks and never takes falling damage.
design_note: Two unblockable dice at range 9 is efficient wound output, but the alternating-turn restriction, order-marker burn on a 30% roll, and effectively zero defense in melee all cut her real damage per order marker.

name: Malbrecht the Hollow Voice
ability_1_desc: Range 4. Attack 4. Choose a figure to attack. All figures adjacent to the chosen figure are also affected by Hollow Scream Special Attack, even figures you control. Roll attack dice once for all affected figures. Each affected figure rolls defense dice separately.
ability_2_desc: After attacking with Hollow Scream Special Attack, roll the 20-sided die. If you roll a 1-7, place one Wound Marker on this Army Card.
ability_3_desc: After taking a turn with Malbrecht the Hollow Voice, roll the 20-sided die. If you roll a 1 or 2, choose an opponent. That opponent now controls Malbrecht the Hollow Voice. Remove any Order Markers on this Army Card, then give this card to that opponent.
ability_4_desc: Malbrecht the Hollow Voice may attack with Hollow Scream Special Attack without clear line of sight to the chosen figure, as long as the chosen figure is within 4 spaces.
design_note: A no-line-of-sight area special attack is squad-shredding value, but stacking a 35% self-wound with a 10% per-turn chance of handing the card to an opponent makes the pricing hinge on how many turns he realistically survives under your control.

name: Vashri Bloodveil
ability_1_desc: After revealing an Order Marker on Vashri Bloodveil and before taking her turn, roll the 20-sided die. If you roll a 6 or lower, an opponent of your choice takes Vashri Bloodveil's turn instead of you. That opponent may move Vashri Bloodveil and attack with her as if she were their own figure, and may attack figures you control.
ability_2_desc: If Vashri Bloodveil destroys an adjacent figure with a normal attack, she may immediately attack one additional adjacent figure. Vashri Bloodveil cannot attack the same figure more than once per turn.
ability_3_desc: When Vashri Bloodveil rolls defense dice against a normal attack from an adjacent attacking figure, she cannot roll more than 1 die for defense.
design_note: Attack 6 with chained kills is elite offense, but a 30% chance per Order Marker of handing her to an opponent plus a one-die melee defense cap makes her expected output and survivability wildly swingy.

name: Ruk-Tar the Pain-Bound
ability_1_desc: Before attacking with Ruk-Tar the Pain-Bound, you may place 1 Wound Marker on Ruk-Tar the Pain-Bound. If you do, add 3 dice to each of Ruk-Tar's normal attacks for the rest of this turn. You may not use Pain-Fueled Rage if it would destroy Ruk-Tar.
ability_2_desc: If there is an opponent's figure within 6 clear sight spaces of Ruk-Tar the Pain-Bound when you begin his turn, Ruk-Tar must move as close as possible to the nearest opponent's figure, and he must attack that figure if he is able to attack.
ability_3_desc: Ruk-Tar the Pain-Bound is never attacked when leaving an engagement, and he does not have to stop his movement when entering water spaces.
design_note: Attack 7 on demand is premium damage, but each use burns a life from a Defense 2 body and Blood Scent removes all target selection, so the effective life total and tactical value are both far lower than the printed numbers suggest.

name: Conscript of the Burning Oath
ability_1_desc: Before attacking with a Conscript of the Burning Oath, you may place one Wound Marker on that Conscript of the Burning Oath. If you do, add 3 dice to that Conscript's normal attack this turn. You may not use Martyr's Zeal if it would destroy that Conscript of the Burning Oath.
ability_2_desc: A Conscript of the Burning Oath can never move away from an engagement. If a Conscript of the Burning Oath is engaged when you begin its turn, it must attack an adjacent opponent's figure if it is able to attack.
design_note: A common hero with a self-inflicted Attack 6 swing is a cheap burst threat, but the wound leaves it at one life and it can never retreat, so the card is priced almost entirely on its one good turn.

name: Brannik Ironsight
ability_1_desc: Brannik Ironsight cannot move and attack in the same turn. If Brannik Ironsight moves at all during his turn, he may not attack this turn.
ability_2_desc: After attacking with Brannik Ironsight, roll the 20-sided die. If you roll a 7 or lower, place one Wound Marker on Brannik Ironsight.
ability_3_desc: When Brannik Ironsight attacks a figure at least 5 clear sight spaces away, add 1 die to that attack.
design_note: Range 9 Attack 5 at long distance is among the best sniping in the game, but Move 4, no move-and-shoot, and a 35% chance of self-wounding per shot make it unclear whether he outvalues a plain Range 7 hero.

name: Gorrumox the Untamed
ability_1_desc: After revealing an Order Marker on Gorrumox the Untamed and before taking his turn, roll the 20-sided die. If you roll a 7 or lower, an opponent of your choice takes Gorrumox the Untamed's turn instead of you. That opponent may move Gorrumox and attack with him as if he were their own figure, and may attack any figures, including figures you control.
ability_2_desc: Instead of attacking normally, Gorrumox the Untamed may attack each Small or Medium figure adjacent to him. Roll each attack separately.
ability_3_desc: If Gorrumox the Untamed moved at least 4 spaces during his turn, add 1 die to each attack he makes this turn.
design_note: Seven life with a charging multi-target Attack 6 stomp reads like a 200-point monster, but a 35% chance per Order Marker that an opponent swings him into your own army makes the drawback discount enormous and difficult to size.

name: Grissom Redmaw
ability_1_desc: After revealing an Order Marker on this Army Card and before taking a turn with Grissom Redmaw, the player to your left rolls the 20-sided die. If they roll an 8 or lower, that player takes this turn with Grissom Redmaw instead of you, moving and attacking with him as if he were their own figure. Grissom Redmaw is still considered to be a figure you control for all other purposes.
ability_2_desc: After attacking with Grissom Redmaw with a normal attack, you may choose one additional figure adjacent to Grissom Redmaw and attack it with a normal attack. If you do, place 1 wound marker on this Army Card after that attack is resolved.
design_note: A 5-attack melee hero with a coin-flip chance every order marker of handing the turn to an opponent, so his effective offense is barely over half of what his stats suggest.

name: Skarn Ironbelly
ability_1_desc: After moving and before attacking with this Skarn Ironbelly, you must roll the 20-sided die. If you roll a 1-9, instead of attacking normally, this Skarn Ironbelly must attack each figure adjacent to it one time, including figures you control. If you roll a 10 or higher, it may attack normally.
ability_2_desc: If this Skarn Ironbelly rolls no skulls when attacking with a normal attack, place 1 wound marker on this Army Card.
design_note: Huge life and a 6-attack are dragged down by a coin-flip friendly-fire power and self-wounding on whiffed attacks, and the Uncommon tag means multiple copies can share the risk.

name: Ashpit Flagellants
ability_1_desc: Before moving with the Ashpit Flagellants, you may choose one Ashpit Flagellant you control and destroy it. If you do, all Ashpit Flagellants you control add 1 to their Attack Value for the rest of the round. Opponents do not receive points for Ashpit Flagellants destroyed with Self-Flagellation.
ability_2_desc: When you take a turn with the Ashpit Flagellants, each Flagellant that can end its movement closer to the nearest opponent's figure within its clear sight must do so, and must attack an adjacent opponent's figure if it is able.
design_note: Attack 4 on a common squad is above curve, but defense 1 plus mandatory advance-and-attack means they die to almost anything and can never be played defensively.

name: Deputy Odell Crane
ability_1_desc: Odell Crane cannot move and attack on the same turn. If Odell Crane moves any spaces on his turn, his turn immediately ends after he finishes moving.
ability_2_desc: At the start of the game, choose one opponent's Unique Hero. That Hero is Odell Crane's Grudge. If the Grudge Hero is within 8 clear sight spaces of Odell Crane, Odell Crane must attack the Grudge Hero and may not attack any other figure this turn.
ability_3_desc: If Odell Crane receives one or more wounds from a normal attack and is not destroyed, he cannot be given an Order Marker during the next Order Marker placement phase.
design_note: Range 8 with attack 5 is sniper-tier firepower, but forced targeting, no move-and-shoot, and an order-marker lockout after taking a wound gut his reliability.

name: Ysolde Halfveil
ability_1_desc: At the end of each round, roll the 20-sided die. If you roll a 3 or lower, remove Ysolde Halfveil from the battlefield. She is not destroyed and no player receives points for her. She takes no further part in the game, and any Order Markers on this Army Card are removed.
ability_2_desc: When Ysolde Halfveil attacks an opponent's figure that is not adjacent to any other figure you control, she adds 2 dice to her attack.
ability_3_desc: When counting spaces for Ysolde Halfveil's movement, ignore elevations. Ysolde Halfveil may fly over water without stopping, pass over figures without becoming engaged, and fly over obstacles such as ruins. When Ysolde Halfveil starts to fly, if she is engaged she will not take any leaving engagement attacks.
ability_4_desc: Ysolde Halfveil is never attacked when leaving an engagement.
design_note: An attack-6 flying assassin whose whole investment can simply evaporate on a 15% roll each round, making her value a gamble on how fast the game ends.

name: Mortar Servitor SV-3
ability_1_desc: After attacking with a Mortar Servitor SV-3, roll the 20-sided die. If you roll a 4 or lower, destroy that Mortar Servitor SV-3. Opponents receive points for Mortar Servitors destroyed with Overheated Barrel.
ability_2_desc: A Mortar Servitor SV-3 cannot move and attack on the same turn. If a Mortar Servitor SV-3 moves any spaces on its turn, its turn immediately ends after it finishes moving.
ability_3_desc: When a Mortar Servitor SV-3 attacks a figure that is at least 3 levels below it, that figure cannot roll more than 2 defense dice.
design_note: A one-life common hero with range 7 and attack 4 that destroys itself one time in five and must sit still, so it prices somewhere between a cheap turret and a glorified order-marker sink.

name: Gharrowbeak the Ravenous
ability_1_desc: After moving with Gharrowbeak the Ravenous, he must attack the figure nearest to him, even if that figure is one you control. If two or more figures are equally near, you choose which of those figures he attacks.
ability_2_desc: Each time Gharrowbeak the Ravenous destroys a small or medium figure with a normal attack, you may remove 1 wound marker from this Army Card.
ability_3_desc: Gharrowbeak the Ravenous does not have to stop his movement when entering water spaces, and he never rolls for falling damage.
design_note: Move 7 with attack 5 and self-healing is aggressive-hero pricing, but forced nearest-figure targeting punishes any army that wants to screen him with cheap squads.

name: Brother Lucian Palewatch
ability_1_desc: After moving and before attacking with Brother Lucian Palewatch, you may choose an adjacent figure you control. Remove 1 wound marker from that figure's Army Card and place 1 wound marker on this Army Card. Brother Lucian Palewatch cannot use Sacrificial Mending if it would destroy him.
ability_2_desc: Add 1 to Brother Lucian Palewatch's Attack Value for each wound marker on this Army Card.
ability_3_desc: Wound markers may never be removed from this Army Card by any special power, Glyph, or other game effect.
design_note: He converts his own life total into both healing for the army and escalating attack, so his value depends entirely on how efficiently an opponent can finish off a hero who can never be healed.

name: Thane Borrik Ironvow
ability_1_desc: If Thane Borrik Ironvow does not move on his turn, add 3 to his Defense Value until the end of the round.
ability_2_desc: After moving and before attacking with Thane Borrik Ironvow, you may choose an adjacent Small or Medium enemy figure and roll the 20-sided die. If you roll a 13 or higher, the chosen figure may roll no more than 1 die for defense against Thane Borrik Ironvow's normal attack this turn.
design_note: A slow, low-attack wall whose value hinges on whether the defensive stance can actually be used while holding a choke point.

name: Thane Borrik Ironvow (variant)
ability_1_desc: If Thane Borrik Ironvow does not move on his turn, add 3 to his Defense Value until the end of the round.
ability_2_desc: After moving and before attacking with Thane Borrik Ironvow, you may choose an adjacent Small or Medium enemy figure and roll the 20-sided die. If you roll a 13 or higher, the chosen figure may roll no more than 1 die for defense against Thane Borrik Ironvow's normal attack this turn.
ability_3_desc: All friendly figures within 4 clear sight spaces of Thane Borrik Ironvow add 1 die when rolling defense dice. Thane Borrik Ironvow is not affected by Aura of the Ironvow.
design_note: The added defense aura is worth far more on a figure that already wants to sit still behind a squad screen, so the premium over the base card is larger than a flat aura tax.

name: Ursine Warder
ability_1_desc: If this Ursine Warder is adjacent to another Ursine or Knight figure you control, add 1 to this Ursine Warder's Defense Value.
ability_2_desc: Range 1. Attack 3. Instead of attacking normally with this Ursine Warder, you may choose up to 2 adjacent enemy figures. Roll 3 attack dice separately against each chosen figure. Each chosen figure rolls defense dice separately.
design_note: An uncommon hero priced per copy, so its value depends on how many are fielded together and how reliably the adjacency bonus is met.

name: Ursine Warder (variant)
ability_1_desc: If this Ursine Warder is adjacent to another Ursine or Knight figure you control, add 1 to this Ursine Warder's Defense Value.
ability_2_desc: Range 1. Attack 3. Instead of attacking normally with this Ursine Warder, you may choose up to 2 adjacent enemy figures. Roll 3 attack dice separately against each chosen figure. Each chosen figure rolls defense dice separately.
ability_3_desc: All friendly figures within 4 clear sight spaces of this Ursine Warder add 1 die when rolling attack dice. Ursine Warders are not affected by Warcry of the North Aura.
design_note: Because this is an uncommon hero, multiple copies stack their attack auras on the same squads, so the aura is worth far more than a single-hero aura would be.

name: Frontier Pathfinder
ability_1_desc: If a Frontier Pathfinder does not move on its turn, add 1 to its Attack Value and 2 to its Range Value for that turn.
ability_2_desc: A Frontier Pathfinder does not have to stop its movement when entering water spaces, and is never attacked when leaving an engagement with a figure whose Move Value is 4 or less.
design_note: A cheap common hero whose stand-still bonus competes with its own high movement, making its effective output hard to pin down.

name: Frontier Pathfinder (variant)
ability_1_desc: If a Frontier Pathfinder does not move on its turn, add 1 to its Attack Value and 2 to its Range Value for that turn.
ability_2_desc: A Frontier Pathfinder does not have to stop its movement when entering water spaces, and is never attacked when leaving an engagement with a figure whose Move Value is 4 or less.
ability_3_desc: All friendly figures within 4 clear sight spaces of a Frontier Pathfinder add 1 to their Move Value. Frontier Pathfinders are not affected by Pathfinder's Trail Aura.
design_note: An army-wide movement aura attached to a cheap, stackable common hero risks being undercosted no matter how modest the base figure is.

name: Captain Rhoswen Vale
ability_1_desc: If Captain Rhoswen Vale is attacked and at least 1 skull is rolled, before rolling defense dice you may roll the 20-sided die. If you roll a 15 or higher, Captain Rhoswen Vale takes no wounds from that attack. If you roll a 14 or lower, roll defense dice normally.
ability_2_desc: Captain Rhoswen Vale is never attacked when leaving an engagement.
design_note: A clean baseline knight whose only edge is a 25% damage-negation roll, making her the control point for the pair's aura premium.

name: Captain Rhoswen Vale (variant)
ability_1_desc: If Captain Rhoswen Vale is attacked and at least 1 skull is rolled, before rolling defense dice you may roll the 20-sided die. If you roll a 15 or higher, Captain Rhoswen Vale takes no wounds from that attack. If you roll a 14 or lower, roll defense dice normally.
ability_2_desc: Captain Rhoswen Vale is never attacked when leaving an engagement.
ability_3_desc: All friendly figures you control who follow Jandar add 1 die to their defense rolls while they are within 4 clear sight spaces of Captain Rhoswen Vale. Captain Rhoswen Vale is not affected by Vanguard Aura.
design_note: The added defense aura only pays off in a Jandar-heavy army and requires clustering within sight, so its premium is real but conditional.

name: Gruk Bonesplitter
ability_1_desc: If Gruk Bonesplitter moves 4 or more spaces before attacking, he rolls 1 additional attack die this turn.
ability_2_desc: When Gruk Bonesplitter attacks a figure whose Life Value is higher than his, he rolls 1 additional attack die.
design_note: Glass-cannon math (A5 with two conditional bonus dice but only D2 and L4) makes the baseline price swingy before any aura is added.

name: Gruk Bonesplitter (variant)
ability_1_desc: If Gruk Bonesplitter moves 4 or more spaces before attacking, he rolls 1 additional attack die this turn.
ability_2_desc: When Gruk Bonesplitter attacks a figure whose Life Value is higher than his, he rolls 1 additional attack die.
ability_3_desc: All friendly figures you control who follow Utgar add 1 die to their normal attacks while they are within 4 clear sight spaces of Gruk Bonesplitter. Gruk Bonesplitter is not affected by Warcry of the Bloodmoon.
design_note: An attack aura is the most valuable of the three aura types, but it sits on a fragile D2 hero the opponent can snipe to shut the aura off.

name: Sylvaine Thornquill
ability_1_desc: Before moving with Sylvaine Thornquill, you may choose one opponent's figure within 8 clear sight spaces of her. Sylvaine Thornquill rolls 1 additional attack die when attacking the chosen figure this turn.
ability_2_desc: Sylvaine Thornquill increases her Defense Value by 1 when defending against a non-adjacent figure.
design_note: A range-6 attack-3 hero with a near-automatic bonus die blurs the line between ordinary ranged hero and premium sniper.

name: Sylvaine Thornquill (variant)
ability_1_desc: Before moving with Sylvaine Thornquill, you may choose one opponent's figure within 8 clear sight spaces of her. Sylvaine Thornquill rolls 1 additional attack die when attacking the chosen figure this turn.
ability_2_desc: Sylvaine Thornquill increases her Defense Value by 1 when defending against a non-adjacent figure.
ability_3_desc: All friendly figures you control who follow Ullar add 1 to their Move Value while they are within 4 clear sight spaces of Sylvaine Thornquill when they begin their movement. Sylvaine Thornquill is not affected by Windrunner's Grace.
design_note: A +1 move aura is the weakest of the three aura types and is awkward on a back-line shooter who wants distance from her own troops.

name: Torgrim Hammerfall
ability_1_desc: After taking a turn with Torgrim Hammerfall, you may roll the 20-sided die. If you roll a 13 or higher, you may immediately take another turn with Torgrim Hammerfall. You may only use Berserker Charge 13 once per turn.
ability_2_desc: Torgrim Hammerfall is never attacked when leaving an engagement with a figure whose base is at least 1 level below Torgrim Hammerfall's base.
design_note: A high-attack, low-defense melee hero whose repeat-turn d20 power already doubles his output, making the baseline hard to separate from aura value.

name: Torgrim Hammerfall (variant)
ability_1_desc: After taking a turn with Torgrim Hammerfall, you may roll the 20-sided die. If you roll a 13 or higher, you may immediately take another turn with Torgrim Hammerfall. You may only use Berserker Charge 13 once per turn.
ability_2_desc: Torgrim Hammerfall is never attacked when leaving an engagement with a figure whose base is at least 1 level below Torgrim Hammerfall's base.
ability_3_desc: All friendly Dwarf figures within 4 clear sight spaces of Torgrim Hammerfall roll 1 additional attack die when attacking with a normal attack.
design_note: The added attack aura is worth almost nothing without Dwarf squads on the card pool but enormous alongside a 4-figure Dwarf common squad, so the premium is entirely army-dependent.

name: Zetch Voltcaller
ability_1_desc: Range 5. Attack 2. Choose a figure to attack. You may also choose up to 2 additional figures within 2 clear sight spaces of the targeted figure to be affected by Arc Coil Special Attack. Roll attack dice once for all affected figures. Each affected figure rolls defense dice separately.
ability_2_desc: After moving and instead of attacking with Zetch Voltcaller, you may choose a friendly Soulborg figure adjacent to Zetch Voltcaller and roll the 20-sided die. If you roll a 15 or higher, remove 1 wound marker from that figure's Army Card.
design_note: A multi-target special attack plus conditional healing on a durable ranged chassis blurs how much of the cost is offense versus support.

name: Zetch Voltcaller (variant)
ability_1_desc: Range 5. Attack 2. Choose a figure to attack. You may also choose up to 2 additional figures within 2 clear sight spaces of the targeted figure to be affected by Arc Coil Special Attack. Roll attack dice once for all affected figures. Each affected figure rolls defense dice separately.
ability_2_desc: After moving and instead of attacking with Zetch Voltcaller, you may choose a friendly Soulborg figure adjacent to Zetch Voltcaller and roll the 20-sided die. If you roll a 15 or higher, remove 1 wound marker from that figure's Army Card.
ability_3_desc: All friendly Soulborg figures within 4 clear sight spaces of Zetch Voltcaller roll 1 additional defense die when rolling defense against a normal attack.
design_note: Stacking a defense aura onto an already high-defense ranged support hero creates a defensive anchor whose value grows non-linearly with the number of Soulborgs nearby.  ...the aura also protects the aura-giver's own screen.

name: Warden Olthuun
ability_1_desc: After moving and before attacking with this Warden Olthuun, you may choose one Small or Medium enemy figure within 2 clear sight spaces and roll the 20-sided die. If you roll a 13 or higher, that figure cannot move during its next turn. It may still attack.
ability_2_desc: This Warden Olthuun does not have to stop its movement when entering any water or brush space, and it may move through jungle and tree spaces as if they were empty.
design_note: A slow Large hero with a soft crowd-control d20 power sits awkwardly between a tank and a utility piece, and 'uncommon' lets an army run several at once.

name: Warden Olthuun (variant)
ability_1_desc: After moving and before attacking with this Warden Olthuun, you may choose one Small or Medium enemy figure within 2 clear sight spaces and roll the 20-sided die. If you roll a 13 or higher, that figure cannot move during its next turn. It may still attack.
ability_2_desc: This Warden Olthuun does not have to stop its movement when entering any water or brush space, and it may move through jungle and tree spaces as if they were empty.
ability_3_desc: All friendly figures within 4 clear sight spaces of this Warden Olthuun roll 1 additional defense die when rolling defense against a normal attack. A figure may only be affected by one Greenwarden's Vigil Aura at a time.
design_note: An unrestricted defense aura on a multi-copy Uncommon Hero is the strongest possible aura scope, but the explicit no-stacking clause and the figure's low Move cap how often it can be delivered where needed.

name: Sister Anwyn Thornlight
ability_1_desc: After moving and before attacking with Sister Anwyn Thornlight, you may choose a wounded friendly Hero within 4 clear sight spaces of Sister Anwyn and roll the 20-sided die. If you roll an 8 or higher, remove 1 Wound Marker from that Hero's Army Card. If you roll a 1, Sister Anwyn Thornlight cannot attack this turn.
ability_2_desc: All friendly Unique Heroes adjacent to Sister Anwyn Thornlight roll 1 additional defense die when defending against a normal attack.
ability_3_desc: Sister Anwyn Thornlight never rolls for falling damage and is never affected by special attacks that target more than one figure at once.
design_note: Repeatable off-turn-free healing at a 65% success rate is a soft, army-dependent value that scales with how expensive the heroes she is attached to are.

name: Sister Anwyn Thornlight (variant)
ability_1_desc: After moving and before attacking with Sister Anwyn Thornlight, you may choose a wounded friendly Hero within 4 clear sight spaces of Sister Anwyn and roll the 20-sided die. If you roll a 15 or higher, remove 1 Wound Marker from that Hero's Army Card. If you roll a 1, Sister Anwyn Thornlight cannot attack this turn.
ability_2_desc: All friendly Unique Heroes adjacent to Sister Anwyn Thornlight roll 1 additional defense die when defending against a normal attack.
ability_3_desc: Sister Anwyn Thornlight never rolls for falling damage and is never affected by special attacks that target more than one figure at once.
design_note: At 30% success the healing becomes a bonus rather than a plan, so nearly all of the card's worth shifts onto a 2-attack body and a small adjacency aura.

name: Swampbrood Lurkers
ability_1_desc: When a Swampbrood Lurker you control is destroyed by an adjacent opponent's figure, roll the 20-sided die. If you roll an 11 or higher, the figure that destroyed that Swampbrood Lurker receives 1 wound. Marro figures are never affected by Toxic Barbs.
ability_2_desc: Swampbrood Lurkers may move through all water spaces and swamp water spaces without stopping, and they never roll for swamp water damage.
ability_3_desc: When a Swampbrood Lurker you control is defending against a normal attack from a non-adjacent figure and it is adjacent to another Swampbrood Lurker you control, it rolls 1 additional defense die.
design_note: A 50% retaliatory wound on every one of four cheap 1-life bodies can quietly out-trade the squad's own cost, making the threshold swing worth more than the base statline.

name: Swampbrood Lurkers (variant)
ability_1_desc: When a Swampbrood Lurker you control is destroyed by an adjacent opponent's figure, roll the 20-sided die. If you roll a 17 or higher, the figure that destroyed that Swampbrood Lurker receives 1 wound. Marro figures are never affected by Toxic Barbs.
ability_2_desc: Swampbrood Lurkers may move through all water spaces and swamp water spaces without stopping, and they never roll for swamp water damage.
ability_3_desc: When a Swampbrood Lurker you control is defending against a normal attack from a non-adjacent figure and it is adjacent to another Swampbrood Lurker you control, it rolls 1 additional defense die.
design_note: At 20% the barbs are mostly flavor, so the squad must be priced almost entirely as a vanilla A3 D2 melee common with water tricks.

name: Vector Sentinel
ability_1_desc: Instead of moving normally with this Vector Sentinel, you may choose another Soulborg you control within 10 clear sight spaces and roll the 20-sided die. If you roll an 8 or higher, place this Vector Sentinel on any empty space adjacent to that Soulborg. If you roll a 7 or lower, this Vector Sentinel cannot move or attack this turn.
ability_2_desc: Range 6. Attack 2. Choose a figure to attack. You may also choose one other figure within 3 clear sight spaces of the targeted figure to be affected by Suppression Volley Special Attack. Roll attack dice once for all affected figures. Each figure rolls defense dice separately.
ability_3_desc: All friendly Soulborg figures adjacent to this Vector Sentinel add 1 to their Range value when attacking a non-adjacent figure.
design_note: Reliable repositioning plus a whiff clause creates a high-variance tempo engine whose value depends heavily on whether the relay lands often enough to be an every-turn plan.

name: Vector Sentinel (variant)
ability_1_desc: Instead of moving normally with this Vector Sentinel, you may choose another Soulborg you control within 10 clear sight spaces and roll the 20-sided die. If you roll a 15 or higher, place this Vector Sentinel on any empty space adjacent to that Soulborg. If you roll a 14 or lower, this Vector Sentinel cannot move or attack this turn.
ability_2_desc: Range 6. Attack 2. Choose a figure to attack. You may also choose one other figure within 3 clear sight spaces of the targeted figure to be affected by Suppression Volley Special Attack. Roll attack dice once for all affected figures. Each figure rolls defense dice separately.
ability_3_desc: All friendly Soulborg figures adjacent to this Vector Sentinel add 1 to their Range value when attacking a non-adjacent figure.
design_note: With only a 30% chance the relay is a trap that wastes whole turns, so the drawback clause may actually make the power a net negative rather than a discount.

name: Whisperwind Longbows
ability_1_desc: After a Whisperwind Longbow you control attacks a non-adjacent figure with a normal attack and that figure receives no wounds, roll the 20-sided die. If you roll an 11 or higher, the defending figure receives 1 wound.
ability_2_desc: When a Whisperwind Longbow you control attacks a figure whose base is at least 3 levels below its base, it adds 1 to its Attack value.
ability_3_desc: Before taking a turn with Whisperwind Longbows, you may first take a turn with any Elf Wizard you control.
design_note: A 50% consolation wound on every missed shot effectively raises a 3-die volley's damage floor across three figures, which compounds far past what a single-figure d20 power would be worth.

name: Whisperwind Longbows (variant)
ability_1_desc: After a Whisperwind Longbow you control attacks a non-adjacent figure with a normal attack and that figure receives no wounds, roll the 20-sided die. If you roll a 17 or higher, the defending figure receives 1 wound.
ability_2_desc: When a Whisperwind Longbow you control attacks a figure whose base is at least 3 levels below its base, it adds 1 to its Attack value.
ability_3_desc: Before taking a turn with Whisperwind Longbows, you may first take a turn with any Elf Wizard you control.
design_note: At 20% the miss-conversion barely moves expected damage, leaving bonding and range 6 to carry the price even though the card text looks nearly identical to its twin.

name: Ashera Vaunt
ability_1_desc: After moving and before attacking with Ashera Vaunt, you may choose Ashera Vaunt or any Human or Kyrie figure you control within 3 clear sight spaces and roll the 20-sided die. If you roll an 8 or higher, remove 1 Wound Marker from the chosen figure's Army Card.
ability_2_desc: All Unique Heroes you control who follow Jandar add 1 to their Defense Value while adjacent to Ashera Vaunt.
design_note: A near-coinflip repeatable heal on a sturdy 5-life melee hero is hard to separate from her defensive aura's value to a Jandar hero build.

name: Ashera Vaunt (variant)
ability_1_desc: After moving and before attacking with Ashera Vaunt, you may choose Ashera Vaunt or any Human or Kyrie figure you control within 3 clear sight spaces and roll the 20-sided die. If you roll a 15 or higher, remove 1 Wound Marker from the chosen figure's Army Card.
ability_2_desc: All Unique Heroes you control who follow Jandar add 1 to their Defense Value while adjacent to Ashera Vaunt.
design_note: The heal now succeeds only 30% of the time, so almost all of the card's price must come from its solid base stats and aura.

name: Fenmarsh Stingers
ability_1_desc: If a Fenmarsh Stinger you control inflicts one or more wounds on an opponent's figure with a normal attack, roll the 20-sided die. If you roll an 11 or higher, that figure cannot move on its next turn. Paralyzing Venom does not affect destructible objects.
ability_2_desc: Fenmarsh Stingers do not have to stop their movement when entering water spaces, and add 1 to their Defense Value while on a water or swamp space.
design_note: Move-denial on a 50% roll is a soft form of control that is easy to undervalue on an otherwise weak range-5 attack-2 squad.

name: Fenmarsh Stingers (variant)
ability_1_desc: If a Fenmarsh Stinger you control inflicts one or more wounds on an opponent's figure with a normal attack, roll the 20-sided die. If you roll a 17 or higher, that figure cannot move on its next turn. Paralyzing Venom does not affect destructible objects.
ability_2_desc: Fenmarsh Stingers do not have to stop their movement when entering water spaces, and add 1 to their Defense Value while on a water or swamp space.
design_note: At a 20% success rate the venom becomes an occasional bonus rather than a plan, leaving a plain 3-figure ranged chaff squad.

name: Kharn-Class Enforcer
ability_1_desc: After attacking with a Kharn-Class Enforcer, roll the 20-sided die. If you roll an 8 or higher, you may attack one additional time with that Kharn-Class Enforcer. Targeting Overload may be used only once per turn per Kharn-Class Enforcer.
ability_2_desc: A Kharn-Class Enforcer adds 1 to its Defense Value when defending against a normal attack from a non-adjacent figure.
design_note: A 65% chance at a second range-6 attack pushes a 1-life common hero toward squad-level output while remaining trivially killable.

name: Kharn-Class Enforcer (variant)
ability_1_desc: After attacking with a Kharn-Class Enforcer, roll the 20-sided die. If you roll a 15 or higher, you may attack one additional time with that Kharn-Class Enforcer. Targeting Overload may be used only once per turn per Kharn-Class Enforcer.
ability_2_desc: A Kharn-Class Enforcer adds 1 to its Defense Value when defending against a normal attack from a non-adjacent figure.
design_note: Dropping the extra attack to 30% turns a potential ranged powerhouse into a cheap fragile sniper, testing how steeply the threshold is discounted.

name: Skarn Bogbiters
ability_1_desc: After a Skarn Bogbiter attacks a figure with a normal attack and that figure is not destroyed, you may roll the 20-sided die. If you roll an 11 or higher, the defending figure receives 1 wound. If you roll a 1 or a 2, destroy the attacking Skarn Bogbiter. Venom Spurs has no effect on destructible objects.
ability_2_desc: A Skarn Bogbiter does not have to stop its movement when entering a water space.
design_note: A 50% chance of a free extra wound on every surviving target roughly converts a 3-attack melee squad into a 4-attack squad, but the 10% self-destruct clause claws back some of that value.

name: Skarn Bogbiters (variant)
ability_1_desc: After a Skarn Bogbiter attacks a figure with a normal attack and that figure is not destroyed, you may roll the 20-sided die. If you roll a 17 or higher, the defending figure receives 1 wound. If you roll a 1 or a 2, destroy the attacking Skarn Bogbiter. Venom Spurs has no effect on destructible objects.
ability_2_desc: A Skarn Bogbiter does not have to stop its movement when entering a water space.
design_note: With success at only 20% the risk of destroying your own figure on a 1 or 2 becomes almost as likely as the payoff, making the signature power close to point-neutral.

name: Thalos Windriders
ability_1_desc: Once per turn, before attacking with a Thalos Windrider, you may roll the 20-sided die. If you roll an 11 or higher, the figure attacked by that Thalos Windrider may roll no more than 1 die for defense against that attack.
ability_2_desc: When counting spaces for a Thalos Windrider's movement, ignore elevations. A Thalos Windrider may fly over water without stopping, pass over figures without becoming engaged, and fly over obstacles such as ruins. When a Thalos Windrider starts to fly, if it is engaged it will take any leaving engagement attacks.
design_note: Range 6, attack 3, flying and a coin-flip armor-strip on a high-defense target pushes a three-figure unique squad toward the top of the ranged-squad band.

name: Thalos Windriders (variant)
ability_1_desc: Once per turn, before attacking with a Thalos Windrider, you may roll the 20-sided die. If you roll a 17 or higher, the figure attacked by that Thalos Windrider may roll no more than 1 die for defense against that attack.
ability_2_desc: When counting spaces for a Thalos Windrider's movement, ignore elevations. A Thalos Windrider may fly over water without stopping, pass over figures without becoming engaged, and fly over obstacles such as ruins. When a Thalos Windrider starts to fly, if it is engaged it will take any leaving engagement attacks.
design_note: A 20% armor-strip once per turn is a rare bonus rather than a plan, so this card must be priced almost entirely off flying range-6 attack-3 statlines.

name: Vorgrimm the Mountainbreaker
ability_1_desc: After moving with Vorgrimm the Mountainbreaker, instead of attacking, you may choose one adjacent Small, Medium, or Large figure and roll the 20-sided die. If you roll a 17 or higher, the chosen figure is destroyed. If you roll a 16 or lower, the chosen figure receives 1 wound. Figures affected by Mountainbreaker Slam cannot roll defense dice.
ability_2_desc: When Vorgrimm the Mountainbreaker attacks an adjacent figure whose base is at least 3 levels below Vorgrimm's base, add 2 dice to Vorgrimm's attack.
ability_3_desc: When counting spaces for Vorgrimm the Mountainbreaker's movement, Vorgrimm may move up or down 4 levels of elevation for 1 space of movement. Vorgrimm never rolls for falling damage.
design_note: A 25% chance to auto-destroy any non-Huge figure is swingy and could be worth far more than the 1-wound consolation, so the slam's true value depends heavily on how often a Move 4 Huge hero reaches an adjacent target.

name: Bastion-7
ability_1_desc: All Soulborgs you control that are adjacent to Bastion-7 add 2 dice to their defense when rolling defense against a normal attack from a non-adjacent figure.
ability_2_desc: When Bastion-7 rolls defense dice against a normal attack from an adjacent figure and blocks all of the skulls rolled, the attacking figure receives 1 wound.
ability_3_desc: Bastion-7 may not be moved by any special power on an Army Card or Glyph. Bastion-7 never rolls for falling damage, and is never affected by any special power that would prevent it from moving.
design_note: Defense 7 with a punish-on-clean-block power makes Bastion-7 nearly unkillable by melee squads while contributing almost nothing offensively, so its worth swings wildly depending on whether the opposing army has range.

name: Grovetender Oakthane
ability_1_desc: Range 1. Attack 3. Choose up to 3 figures adjacent to this Grovetender Oakthane. Roll attack dice once for all affected figures. Each affected figure rolls defense dice separately.
ability_2_desc: After taking a turn with this Grovetender Oakthane, if it did not move during that turn, you may remove 1 wound marker from this Grovetender Oakthane's Army Card.
ability_3_desc: When this Grovetender Oakthane is destroyed, roll the 20-sided die. If you roll a 15 or higher, choose 3 spaces in a straight line from the space this Grovetender Oakthane occupied. All figures on those spaces receive 1 wound.
design_note: Self-healing that requires standing still fights directly against a 3-target melee area attack, so the card's effective output depends on which power the player gives up each turn.

name: Sir Gauthar the Unyielding
ability_1_desc: When an opponent's figure targets a friendly Small or Medium figure adjacent to Sir Gauthar the Unyielding for a normal attack, you may choose Sir Gauthar as the target of that attack instead. Sir Gauthar rolls his own defense dice against that attack. Sir Gauthar may not be chosen with Bulwark of Jandar more than once per attacking figure's turn.
ability_2_desc: If Sir Gauthar the Unyielding receives one or more wounds from a normal attack and is not destroyed, roll the 20-sided die. If you roll an 11 or higher, the attacking figure receives 1 wound.
ability_3_desc: All Knights you control, except Sir Gauthar the Unyielding, add 1 die to their defense when rolling defense against a normal attack from an adjacent figure.
design_note: Redirecting enemy attacks onto a Defense 6 body is a powerful squad-protection engine whose value scales with the number of cheap Knights alongside him, making him nearly unpriceable in isolation.

name: Nharr-Zhek the Bone Bastion
ability_1_desc: At the end of each round, for each opponent's figure adjacent to Nharr-Zhek the Bone Bastion, roll the 20-sided die. If you roll a 13 or higher, that figure receives 1 wound.
ability_2_desc: Each time one or more figures are destroyed by Nharr-Zhek the Bone Bastion's normal attack, place 1 bone marker on this Army Card. Nharr-Zhek adds 1 die to his defense for each bone marker on this Army Card, to a maximum of 3 additional dice.
ability_3_desc: Before taking a turn with Nharr-Zhek the Bone Bastion, you may first take a turn with one Undead Squad you control.
design_note: Bonding on a Defense 6 Huge body that grows to Defense 9 while passively wounding everything next to it stacks three separate premium effects, so small pricing errors compound badly.

name: Aegis Prime
ability_1_desc: All friendly figures adjacent to Aegis Prime roll 1 additional defense die when defending against a normal attack.
ability_2_desc: Aegis Prime is never affected by an opponent's special powers that would move him from the space he occupies, and he is never affected by knockback or trample special powers. Aegis Prime never rolls for falling damage.
ability_3_desc: When Aegis Prime rolls defense dice against a normal attack from an adjacent figure, each excess shield counts as an unblockable hit on the attacking figure, to a maximum of 2 hits.
design_note: A pure immobile wall with no ranged or special attack, whose value comes almost entirely from a stacking defensive aura that only pays off in a crowded line.

name: Morvath the Grinding Doom
ability_1_desc: At any point while moving, Morvath may choose a Small or Medium figure that is adjacent, on the same level, and on a space where Morvath may end his movement. Roll the 20-sided die. If you roll 1-7, the chosen figure is unaffected and Morvath must end his movement. If you roll 8 or higher, the chosen figure receives 1 wound, and you may place that figure on any empty space adjacent to the space it occupied. Morvath may then continue moving.
ability_2_desc: Range 1. Attack 4. All figures adjacent to Morvath are affected by Rubble Sweep Special Attack. Roll attack dice once for all affected figures. Each figure rolls defense dice separately.
ability_3_desc: When Morvath attacks a destructible object, or a figure whose Life number is 7 or higher, he rolls 2 additional attack dice.
design_note: Stacking a repeatable trample, a full area special attack, and a conditional +2 attack on an already enormous attack 6 chassis makes the offensive ceiling hard to separate from dragon-tier pricing.

name: Thal-Mora the Tidewall
ability_1_desc: Thal-Mora does not have to stop her movement when entering water spaces. While Thal-Mora occupies a water space, she rolls 1 additional defense die against all attacks.
ability_2_desc: An opponent's figure must end its movement when it moves into a space adjacent to Thal-Mora. Figures with Flying are not affected by Grasping Coils.
ability_3_desc: Range 2. Attack 3. After attacking with Undertow Special Attack, if the defending figure was not destroyed, you may place that figure on any empty space adjacent to Thal-Mora that is on the same level or lower than the space it occupied.
design_note: A zone-lock power that stops enemy movement is worth far more on certain maps than others, so its board-control value is almost impossible to average into a flat cost.

name: Bramblewrought Elder
ability_1_desc: If this Bramblewrought Elder moves 1 or more spaces on its turn, it cannot attack during that turn.
ability_2_desc: Range 2. Attack 4. This Bramblewrought Elder may only use Thornlash Special Attack if it did not move on this turn. Figures attacked by Thornlash Special Attack that are adjacent to a tree or bush roll 1 fewer defense die.
ability_3_desc: At the end of a round, if this Bramblewrought Elder is adjacent to a tree or bush and did not move during that round, you may remove 1 wound marker from this Army Card.
design_note: A severe cannot-move-and-attack drawback is paired with self-healing and terrain-dependent bonus dice, so the card is either a cheap immobile turret or a strong anchor depending entirely on the map's foliage.

name: Cinderplate Juggernaut
ability_1_desc: Once per round, instead of moving and attacking with Cinderplate Juggernaut, you may choose a figure within 8 clear sight spaces of Cinderplate Juggernaut and roll the 20-sided die. If you roll 16 or higher, the chosen figure and each figure adjacent to the chosen figure receives 2 wounds. If you roll 1-15, Cinderplate Juggernaut receives 1 wound.
ability_2_desc: When Cinderplate Juggernaut rolls defense dice against a Special Attack, he rolls 2 additional defense dice.
ability_3_desc: Cinderplate Juggernaut does not have to stop his movement when entering rubble, snow, or lava field spaces, and he never rolls for lava field damage.
design_note: A 25% chance of dealing 2 unblockable wounds to a whole cluster is swingy and self-damaging, so the power's expected value badly understates its game-deciding upside.

name: Quarry Brute
ability_1_desc: Range 5. Attack 3. A Quarry Brute may only use Heave Boulder Special Attack if it did not move on this turn. Figures attacked by Heave Boulder Special Attack must be on the same level as, or lower than, the attacking Quarry Brute.
ability_2_desc: You may not reveal more than one Order Marker on this Army Card each round. If a second Order Marker is revealed on this card during a round, it is discarded and no turn is taken.
ability_3_desc: When a Quarry Brute rolls defense dice against a Special Attack, it rolls 1 additional defense die.
design_note: Common-hero pricing expects cheap stats, but life 7 defense 5 with a ranged special attack is elite for the slot, and the one-order-marker restriction is the only thing holding it down.

name: Colossus of Vespidor
ability_1_desc: After moving and before attacking with the Colossus of Vespidor, roll the 20-sided die once for each opponent's figure adjacent to the Colossus. If you roll 14 or higher, that figure receives 1 wound.
ability_2_desc: All friendly figures that follow Einar and are within 4 clear sight spaces of the Colossus of Vespidor roll 1 additional attack die when attacking destructible objects or Huge figures.
ability_3_desc: The Colossus of Vespidor is never affected by an opponent's special powers that would destroy it without rolling attack dice, and it never receives more than 3 wounds from any single attack or special power.
design_note: Damage caps and immunity to instant-destruction powers are defenses against specific enemy cards rather than average dice, making the effective survivability wildly matchup dependent.
