ability_1_desc: When rolling defense dice for an Ironroot Hammerguard, if that Hammerguard is adjacent to 1 or more other Ironroot Hammerguards you control, add 1 die to his defense.
ability_2_desc: Ironroot Hammerguard may not be moved by any special power on an Army Card or glyph, and they never roll for falling damage.
design_note: Defense 4 that becomes an effective 5 in formation on a move-4 melee squad blurs the line between a cheap wall and a premium anchor.

name: Ironroot Hammerguard (variant)
ability_1_desc: When rolling defense dice for an Ironroot Hammerguard (variant), if that Hammerguard is adjacent to 1 or more other Ironroot Hammerguard (variant) figures you control, add 1 die to his defense.
ability_2_desc: Ironroot Hammerguard (variant) may not be moved by any special power on an Army Card or glyph, and they never roll for falling damage.
ability_3_desc: Ironroot Hammerguard (variant) figures may not pick up, carry, or be affected by any glyph. Treat any glyph a Hammerguard (variant) occupies as an ordinary space; that glyph's power does not activate and is not revealed by that figure.
design_note: Glyph denial costs a slow melee squad little on glyph-light maps but cripples their role as cheap glyph-sitters on tournament maps.

name: Mordrek Vyle
ability_1_desc: Each time Mordrek Vyle destroys an adjacent figure with a normal attack, you may remove 1 wound marker from this Army Card. Mordrek Vyle cannot Soul Siphon destructible objects.
ability_2_desc: After taking a turn with Mordrek Vyle, you may roll the 20-sided die. If you roll a 15 or higher, choose 1 Small or Medium Common Squad figure you control that has been destroyed this game and place it on an empty space adjacent to Mordrek Vyle.
ability_3_desc: Any opponent's figure that starts its turn adjacent to Mordrek Vyle subtracts 1 from its Move Value for that turn.
design_note: Self-healing plus a 30% per-turn squad resurrection can generate unbounded value in a common-squad army while doing almost nothing in a hero build.

name: Mordrek Vyle (variant)
ability_1_desc: Each time Mordrek Vyle (variant) destroys an adjacent figure with a normal attack, you may remove 1 wound marker from this Army Card. Mordrek Vyle (variant) cannot Soul Siphon destructible objects.
ability_2_desc: After taking a turn with Mordrek Vyle (variant), you may roll the 20-sided die. If you roll a 15 or higher, choose 1 Small or Medium Common Squad figure you control that has been destroyed this game and place it on an empty space adjacent to Mordrek Vyle (variant).
ability_3_desc: Wound markers may never be removed from Mordrek Vyle (variant)'s Army Card by any means, including his own Soul Siphon, other special powers, and glyphs.
design_note: The drawback directly cancels one of his own printed powers, so its cost depends entirely on how often Soul Siphon would have triggered.

name: Sablewind Scouts
ability_1_desc: When a Sablewind Scout attacks an opponent's figure that is adjacent to 1 or more other friendly figures, add 1 die to that Scout's attack.
ability_2_desc: Before taking a turn with a Unique Hero you control, you may first move 1 Sablewind Scout you control up to 3 spaces. That Scout may not attack this turn.
design_note: Range 6 attack 3 with a common conditional bonus and a free half-turn mover sits right at the ceiling for ranged squad pricing.

name: Sablewind Scouts (variant)
ability_1_desc: When a Sablewind Scout (variant) attacks an opponent's figure that is adjacent to 1 or more other friendly figures, add 1 die to that Scout's attack.
ability_2_desc: Before taking a turn with a Unique Hero you control, you may first move 1 Sablewind Scout (variant) you control up to 3 spaces. That Scout may not attack this turn.
ability_3_desc: Whenever a Sablewind Scout (variant) moves, if it is possible for that figure to end its movement on a space adjacent to another friendly figure, it must do so.
design_note: Forced clustering both fuels their own Crossfire and hands opponents easy multi-figure special attack targets on defense 2 bodies.

name: Unit 7-VEX
ability_1_desc: If Unit 7-VEX did not move this turn, add 1 die to its attack.
ability_2_desc: When attacking a figure that is 5 or more spaces away from Unit 7-VEX, all skulls rolled count for one additional hit.
design_note: Low life but a long-range, hit-doubling sniper that only performs when it stands still, so its damage output swings wildly with terrain and map size.

name: Unit 7-VEX (variant)
ability_1_desc: If Unit 7-VEX did not move this turn, add 1 die to its attack.
ability_2_desc: When attacking a figure that is 5 or more spaces away from Unit 7-VEX, all skulls rolled count for one additional hit.
ability_3_desc: When a friendly figure within 4 clear sight spaces of Unit 7-VEX attacks with a normal attack, that figure adds 1 die to its attack. Auras named Firing Solution Aura 1 do not stack.
design_note: An army-wide attack die granted by a figure that wants to sit still in the back line pairs perfectly with ranged squads, but the aura's 4-space leash fights against its own 7-range sniping role.

name: Sludge Hollow Marauder
ability_1_desc: If a Sludge Hollow Marauder moved 4 or more spaces this turn, add 1 die to its attack.
ability_2_desc: Sludge Hollow Marauders are never attacked when leaving an engagement.
design_note: A 1-life common hero is nearly worthless on its own, but Disengage plus a charging attack of 4 makes it a repeatable cheap harasser you can field in multiples.

name: Sludge Hollow Marauder (variant)
ability_1_desc: If a Sludge Hollow Marauder moved 4 or more spaces this turn, add 1 die to its attack.
ability_2_desc: Sludge Hollow Marauders are never attacked when leaving an engagement.
ability_3_desc: All friendly figures that begin their move within 4 clear sight spaces of a Sludge Hollow Marauder you control increase their Move Value by 1. Auras named Hollow Rush Aura 1 do not stack.
design_note: Putting an army-wide move aura on a fragile common hero is the pricing trap: the aura is cheap to buy in multiples but trivially removed by one attack, so it cannot be priced like a durable aura hero.

name: Brialla Thornsong
ability_1_desc: Range 5. Attack 2. If a figure receives at least 1 wound from Entangling Arrow Special Attack, that figure's Move Value is 0 until the end of the round.
ability_2_desc: At the start of each round, before revealing any Order Markers, you may roll the 20-sided die. If you roll a 15 or higher, remove 1 wound marker from Brialla Thornsong or from any friendly Elf you control within 4 clear sight spaces of her.
design_note: Soft control and a 25%-chance heal are both hard to convert into expected damage, so her worth depends almost entirely on whether her army has wounded Elves to mend.

name: Brialla Thornsong (variant)
ability_1_desc: Range 5. Attack 2. If a figure receives at least 1 wound from Entangling Arrow Special Attack, that figure's Move Value is 0 until the end of the round.
ability_2_desc: At the start of each round, before revealing any Order Markers, you may roll the 20-sided die. If you roll a 15 or higher, remove 1 wound marker from Brialla Thornsong or from any friendly Elf you control within 4 clear sight spaces of her.
ability_3_desc: When a friendly figure within 4 clear sight spaces of Brialla Thornsong attacks with a normal attack or a special attack, that figure adds 1 die to its attack. Auras named Thornsong Chorus Aura 1 do not stack.
design_note: Her aura is unusually broad because it also boosts special attacks, which can add several dice to a single volley-style squad and inflate the card's value well past a normal attack aura.

name: Captain Orrin Halewood
ability_1_desc: When rolling defense dice against a normal attack, Captain Orrin Halewood always adds 1 automatic shield to whatever is rolled.
ability_2_desc: If an opponent's Small or Medium figure moves adjacent to Captain Orrin Halewood, roll the 20-sided die. If you roll a 13 or higher, that figure must immediately end its movement. Figures may be targeted only as they move into engagement with Captain Orrin Halewood, and only once per turn.
design_note: A plain melee line-holder whose automatic shield and soft movement-lock are hard to separate from raw defense value.

name: Captain Orrin Halewood (variant)
ability_1_desc: When rolling defense dice against a normal attack, Captain Orrin Halewood always adds 1 automatic shield to whatever is rolled.
ability_2_desc: If an opponent's Small or Medium figure moves adjacent to Captain Orrin Halewood, roll the 20-sided die. If you roll a 13 or higher, that figure must immediately end its movement. Figures may be targeted only as they move into engagement with Captain Orrin Halewood, and only once per turn.
ability_3_desc: All friendly figures within 4 clear sight spaces of Captain Orrin Halewood add 1 die to their defense. A figure may not add more than 1 die for Banner of the Halewood Guard, no matter how many friendly figures with this special power are within 4 clear sight spaces.
design_note: The unrestricted +1 defense die aura scales with however many cheap squad figures you crowd around him, so its worth depends entirely on the army built behind it.

name: Grukka Boneflail
ability_1_desc: Range 1. Attack 3. All figures adjacent to Grukka Boneflail are affected by Flailing Onslaught Special Attack. Roll attack dice once for all affected figures. Each figure rolls defense dice separately. After attacking with Flailing Onslaught Special Attack, Grukka Boneflail receives 1 wound.
ability_2_desc: If there are 1 or more wound markers on Grukka Boneflail's Army Card, add 1 to Grukka Boneflail's Attack Value.
design_note: Self-wounding sweep attack combined with a wound-triggered attack bonus makes his effective damage output rise as his survivability collapses.

name: Grukka Boneflail (variant)
ability_1_desc: Range 1. Attack 3. All figures adjacent to Grukka Boneflail are affected by Flailing Onslaught Special Attack. Roll attack dice once for all affected figures. Each figure rolls defense dice separately. After attacking with Flailing Onslaught Special Attack, Grukka Boneflail receives 1 wound.
ability_2_desc: If there are 1 or more wound markers on Grukka Boneflail's Army Card, add 1 to Grukka Boneflail's Attack Value.
ability_3_desc: All friendly Orc figures within 4 clear sight spaces of Grukka Boneflail add 1 die to their normal attacks. A figure may not add more than 1 die for Blood Howl Aura.
design_note: The attack aura is restricted to Orcs and requires clustering a fragile Defense 2 hero near the front line, so the offensive upside is real but conditional.

name: Sylvan Hornblower
ability_1_desc: When a Sylvan Hornblower is attacked by a non-adjacent figure, and the Sylvan Hornblower is on a jungle space or adjacent to a tree, add 1 die to its defense.
ability_2_desc: Before moving with a Sylvan Hornblower, you may choose a friendly Elf figure within 6 clear sight spaces of that Sylvan Hornblower. Roll the 20-sided die. If you roll a 15 or higher, you may move the chosen figure up to 3 spaces. A figure may be moved only once each turn with Signal Blast 15.
design_note: A cheap common hero with a terrain-dependent defense bump and an unreliable ally-mover, both of which can be fielded in multiples to compound.

name: Sylvan Hornblower (variant)
ability_1_desc: When a Sylvan Hornblower is attacked by a non-adjacent figure, and the Sylvan Hornblower is on a jungle space or adjacent to a tree, add 1 die to its defense.
ability_2_desc: Before moving with a Sylvan Hornblower, you may choose a friendly Elf figure within 6 clear sight spaces of that Sylvan Hornblower. Roll the 20-sided die. If you roll a 15 or higher, you may move the chosen figure up to 3 spaces. A figure may be moved only once each turn with Signal Blast 15.
ability_3_desc: All friendly figures within 4 clear sight spaces of a Sylvan Hornblower add 1 to their Move Value. A figure may not add more than 1 to its Move Value for Rallying Horn Aura, no matter how many Sylvan Hornblowers are within 4 clear sight spaces.
design_note: Because this is a common hero, the aura can be purchased repeatedly for redundant coverage even though the bonus itself does not stack.

name: Halvor Steelbeard
ability_1_desc: If you did not move Halvor Steelbeard on his turn, add 2 to his Defense value until the beginning of his next turn.
ability_2_desc: After attacking an adjacent Small or Medium figure with a normal attack, if the defending figure was not destroyed, roll the 20-sided die. If you roll a 15 or higher, the defending figure receives 1 wound and you may move it 1 space. The chosen space must be empty and may not be more than 1 level higher than the space the defending figure is on.
design_note: A tanky mid-cost melee hero whose Anvil Stance rewards not moving, making his real defense higher than the printed 4 without any aura to pay for.

name: Halvor Steelbeard (variant)
ability_1_desc: If you did not move Halvor Steelbeard on his turn, add 2 to his Defense value until the beginning of his next turn.
ability_2_desc: After attacking an adjacent Small or Medium figure with a normal attack, if the defending figure was not destroyed, roll the 20-sided die. If you roll a 15 or higher, the defending figure receives 1 wound and you may move it 1 space. The chosen space must be empty and may not be more than 1 level higher than the space the defending figure is on.
ability_3_desc: All friendly figures within 4 clear sight spaces of Halvor Steelbeard add 1 die to their defense.
design_note: The added defense aura is worth very little in a small hero-only force but enormous behind a wide screen of common squads, so its price depends entirely on the army built around it.

name: Zurrek Broodcaller
ability_1_desc: If this Zurrek Broodcaller moved at least 4 spaces on his turn before attacking, add 1 die to his attack for the duration of that turn.
ability_2_desc: At the end of each round, if this Zurrek Broodcaller has one or more wound markers on his Army Card, roll the 20-sided die. If you roll a 13 or higher, remove 1 wound marker from this Army Card.
design_note: Self-healing on an uncommon hero that can be fielded in multiples makes each copy better than its raw 5-life, 3-defense profile suggests.

name: Zurrek Broodcaller (variant)
ability_1_desc: If this Zurrek Broodcaller moved at least 4 spaces on his turn before attacking, add 1 die to his attack for the duration of that turn.
ability_2_desc: At the end of each round, if this Zurrek Broodcaller has one or more wound markers on his Army Card, roll the 20-sided die. If you roll a 13 or higher, remove 1 wound marker from this Army Card.
ability_3_desc: All friendly figures within 4 clear sight spaces of this Zurrek Broodcaller add 1 to their Move value. If a figure is within 4 clear sight spaces of more than one Zurrek Broodcaller you control, it still adds only 1 to its Move value.
design_note: A move aura is the weakest of the three aura types in a vacuum, yet on an uncommon hero it can be stacked across several copies for board-wide reach even though the bonus itself does not stack.

name: Ashgrove Halberdier
ability_1_desc: If this Ashgrove Halberdier is attacked with a normal attack by an adjacent figure that moved 3 or more spaces on its turn, add 2 dice to this Ashgrove Halberdier's defense for that attack.
ability_2_desc: When this Ashgrove Halberdier attacks a figure that is engaged with at least 1 other friendly Human figure, add 1 die to his attack.
design_note: A two-life common hero with conditional bonuses on both defense and attack is priced by how often those conditions actually trigger, which varies wildly by army.

name: Ashgrove Halberdier (variant)
ability_1_desc: If this Ashgrove Halberdier is attacked with a normal attack by an adjacent figure that moved 3 or more spaces on its turn, add 2 dice to this Ashgrove Halberdier's defense for that attack.
ability_2_desc: When this Ashgrove Halberdier attacks a figure that is engaged with at least 1 other friendly Human figure, add 1 die to his attack.
ability_3_desc: All friendly figures within 4 clear sight spaces of this Ashgrove Halberdier add 1 die to their defense. If a figure is within 4 clear sight spaces of more than one Ashgrove Halberdier you control, it still adds only 1 die to its defense.
design_note: Putting a faction-wide defense aura on a cheap, fragile common hero that can be fielded in multiples means the aura's value is nearly independent of the figure's own combat stats and hard to price at common-hero rates.

name: Vashri the Flamecaller
ability_1_desc: Instead of attacking with Vashri the Flamecaller, you may choose a non-adjacent figure within 5 clear sight spaces of Vashri and roll the 20-sided die. If you roll an 8 or higher, the chosen figure receives 2 wounds, and each figure adjacent to the chosen figure receives 1 wound. If you roll a 1-7, nothing happens.
ability_2_desc: After using Cinderburst, if the chosen figure was destroyed, you may move Vashri the Flamecaller up to 3 spaces. Vashri may not attack after moving with Ashen Wake.
ability_3_desc: When counting spaces for Vashri's movement, ignore elevations. Vashri may fly over water without stopping, pass over figures without becoming engaged, and fly over obstacles such as ruins. When Vashri starts to fly, if she is engaged she will take any leaving engagement attacks.
design_note: A 65% chance at a 2-wound, no-defense-dice blast with splash damage at range 5 is close to a guaranteed squad-killer each turn, so the card's worth is driven almost entirely by the threshold rather than its ordinary 4-life body.

name: Vashri the Flamecaller (variant)
ability_1_desc: Instead of attacking with Vashri the Flamecaller, you may choose a non-adjacent figure within 5 clear sight spaces of Vashri and roll the 20-sided die. If you roll a 15 or higher, the chosen figure receives 2 wounds, and each figure adjacent to the chosen figure receives 1 wound. If you roll a 1-14, nothing happens.
ability_2_desc: After using Cinderburst, if the chosen figure was destroyed, you may move Vashri the Flamecaller up to 3 spaces. Vashri may not attack after moving with Ashen Wake.
ability_3_desc: When counting spaces for Vashri's movement, ignore elevations. Vashri may fly over water without stopping, pass over figures without becoming engaged, and fly over obstacles such as ruins. When Vashri starts to fly, if she is engaged she will take any leaving engagement attacks.
design_note: At only a 30% success rate the same blast becomes a gamble you often trade away a whole turn for, but the follow-up move and flight keep some floor value, making the drop from the 8+ version hard to size.

name: Sepulcher Ghouls
ability_1_desc: When attacking with a Sepulcher Ghoul you control, if the defending figure has one or more wounds on its Army Card, that Sepulcher Ghoul rolls 1 additional attack die.
ability_2_desc: After an opponent's turn, for each Sepulcher Ghoul you control that was destroyed during that turn, you may roll the 20-sided die. If you roll an 11 or higher, take that Sepulcher Ghoul and place it on any empty space within 3 clear sight spaces of another Sepulcher Ghoul you control. If you roll a 1-10, nothing happens. You may not use Rise Again if you control no Sepulcher Ghouls on the battlefield.
ability_3_desc: Sepulcher Ghouls can move through all other Undead figures you control.
design_note: Recurring half of the squad's casualties every round effectively multiplies the card's life total, so the threshold quietly decides whether this is a cheap chaff squad or a persistent board-control engine.

name: Sepulcher Ghouls (variant)
ability_1_desc: When attacking with a Sepulcher Ghoul you control, if the defending figure has one or more wounds on its Army Card, that Sepulcher Ghoul rolls 1 additional attack die.
ability_2_desc: After an opponent's turn, for each Sepulcher Ghoul you control that was destroyed during that turn, you may roll the 20-sided die. If you roll a 17 or higher, take that Sepulcher Ghoul and place it on any empty space within 3 clear sight spaces of another Sepulcher Ghoul you control. If you roll a 1-16, nothing happens. You may not use Rise Again if you control no Sepulcher Ghouls on the battlefield.
ability_3_desc: Sepulcher Ghouls can move through all other Undead figures you control.
design_note: At 20% the resurrection is a pleasant surprise rather than a plan, but because the roll happens for every ghoul destroyed the swarm can still generate value in large games, complicating a clean discount.

name: Unit 7-Vex
ability_1_desc: After revealing an Order Marker on Unit 7-Vex and before taking its turn, you may choose an opponent's Hero within 6 clear sight spaces of Unit 7-Vex and roll the 20-sided die. If you roll an 11 or higher, until the end of the round that Hero cannot use any of its special powers and subtracts 2 from its Move value. If you roll a 1-10, nothing happens.
ability_2_desc: After an opponent's figure ends its movement within 5 clear sight spaces of Unit 7-Vex, you may roll 1 attack die. If you roll a skull, that figure receives 1 wound. You may use Reactive Fire only once each round.
ability_3_desc: After taking a turn with Unit 7-Vex, if it did not attack this turn, you may remove 1 wound marker from Unit 7-Vex's Army Card.
design_note: Shutting off an enemy Hero's special powers for a round is an effect with no fixed damage value, so its price swings wildly depending on whether the 50% roll lands often enough to be a reliable answer to big Heroes.

name: Unit 7-Vex (variant)
ability_1_desc: After revealing an Order Marker on Unit 7-Vex and before taking its turn, you may choose an opponent's Hero within 6 clear sight spaces of Unit 7-Vex and roll the 20-sided die. If you roll a 17 or higher, until the end of the round that Hero cannot use any of its special powers and subtracts 2 from its Move value. If you roll a 1-16, nothing happens.
ability_2_desc: After an opponent's figure ends its movement within 5 clear sight spaces of Unit 7-Vex, you may roll 1 attack die. If you roll a skull, that figure receives 1 wound. You may use Reactive Fire only once each round.
ability_3_desc: After taking a turn with Unit 7-Vex, if it did not attack this turn, you may remove 1 wound marker from Unit 7-Vex's Army Card.
design_note: Because the pulse costs nothing but a die roll before a normal turn, even a 20% hit rate is pure upside, which means the variant should lose far less value than the raw odds suggest.

name: Ironhold Shieldbearers
ability_1_desc: When an Ironhold Shieldbearer you control rolls defense dice against a normal attack from an adjacent figure, before rolling defense dice you may roll the 20-sided die. If you roll an 8 or higher, one shield will block all damage from that attack. If you roll a 1-7, roll defense dice normally.
ability_2_desc: Before taking a turn with the Ironhold Shieldbearers, you may first take a turn with any Unique Dwarf Hero you control.
ability_3_desc: All figures you control adjacent to an Ironhold Shieldbearer add 1 to their defense dice when rolling defense against a normal attack from a non-adjacent figure.
design_note: Bonding plus a 65% chance to turn a single shield into full damage prevention stacks two of the strongest value multipliers in the game onto a three-figure squad, making the threshold nearly the whole price.

name: Ironhold Shieldbearers (variant)
ability_1_desc: When an Ironhold Shieldbearer you control rolls defense dice against a normal attack from an adjacent figure, before rolling defense dice you may roll the 20-sided die. If you roll a 15 or higher, one shield will block all damage from that attack. If you roll a 1-14, roll defense dice normally.
ability_2_desc: Before taking a turn with the Ironhold Shieldbearers, you may first take a turn with any Unique Dwarf Hero you control.
ability_3_desc: All figures you control adjacent to an Ironhold Shieldbearer add 1 to their defense dice when rolling defense against a normal attack from a non-adjacent figure.
design_note: With only a 30% save the squad's survivability leans back on 3 defense and Bulwark, but the bonding and aura keep the card competitive, so the correct gap between the twins is smaller than the odds difference implies.

name: Grubnak Bogstalkers
ability_1_desc: Instead of attacking with a Grubnak Bogstalker, you may choose an opponent's small or medium figure within 5 clear sight spaces of that Bogstalker and roll the 20-sided die. If you roll an 11 or higher, the chosen figure may not move or be moved until the end of the round. Only one figure may be chosen for Paralyzing Spittle each turn.
ability_2_desc: Grubnak Bogstalkers do not have to stop their movement when entering water spaces.
design_note: Trading a weak 2-attack shot for a 50% chance to strand an enemy hero across the board is hard to value against a plain Range 5 Attack 2 common squad.

name: Grubnak Bogstalkers (variant)
ability_1_desc: Instead of attacking with a Grubnak Bogstalker, you may choose an opponent's small or medium figure within 5 clear sight spaces of that Bogstalker and roll the 20-sided die. If you roll a 17 or higher, the chosen figure may not move or be moved until the end of the round. Only one figure may be chosen for Paralyzing Spittle each turn.
ability_2_desc: Grubnak Bogstalkers do not have to stop their movement when entering water spaces.
design_note: A 20% spittle is almost never worth giving up an attack die roll, so the squad prices as a bare-bones ranged common with a novelty power.

name: Hearthguard of Kandras
ability_1_desc: If a Hearthguard of Kandras would be destroyed by an attack, roll the 20-sided die. If you roll an 11 or higher, that Hearthguard is not destroyed and you ignore all wounds from that attack. You may roll for Oath of Return only once for each Hearthguard of Kandras figure each round.
ability_2_desc: When rolling defense dice against a normal attack, a Hearthguard of Kandras adds 1 die for each other Hearthguard of Kandras adjacent to it.
design_note: Effectively doubling the survivability of three Defense 4 squad figures stacks multiplicatively with Shield Wall, which makes the 11+ version much stronger than a simple dice comparison implies.

name: Hearthguard of Kandras (variant)
ability_1_desc: If a Hearthguard of Kandras would be destroyed by an attack, roll the 20-sided die. If you roll a 17 or higher, that Hearthguard is not destroyed and you ignore all wounds from that attack. You may roll for Oath of Return only once for each Hearthguard of Kandras figure each round.
ability_2_desc: When rolling defense dice against a normal attack, a Hearthguard of Kandras adds 1 die for each other Hearthguard of Kandras adjacent to it.
design_note: A 20% save only rarely changes an engagement, so this version must be priced mostly on three tough but slow Attack 3 melee figures.

name: Tholgrin Anvilbreaker
ability_1_desc: After moving and before attacking with Tholgrin Anvilbreaker, you may choose one adjacent Small or Medium enemy figure and roll the 20-sided die. If you roll an 8 or higher, the chosen figure receives one wound and you may then place that figure on any empty space adjacent to Tholgrin that is not more than 1 level higher than the space it occupied. Tholgrin may still attack normally this turn.
ability_2_desc: When Tholgrin Anvilbreaker rolls defense dice against an adjacent attacking figure's normal attack, if he rolls more shields than the attacking figure rolls skulls, the attacking figure receives one wound. Counter Strike does not affect Destructible Objects.
design_note: Anvil Smash at 8+ is a near-reliable free wound plus repositioning stapled onto solid 5-life melee stats, so the pair's value hinges almost entirely on how often the d20 succeeds.

name: Tholgrin Anvilbreaker (variant)
ability_1_desc: After moving and before attacking with Tholgrin Anvilbreaker, you may choose one adjacent Small or Medium enemy figure and roll the 20-sided die. If you roll a 15 or higher, the chosen figure receives one wound and you may then place that figure on any empty space adjacent to Tholgrin that is not more than 1 level higher than the space it occupied. Tholgrin may still attack normally this turn.
ability_2_desc: When Tholgrin Anvilbreaker rolls defense dice against an adjacent attacking figure's normal attack, if he rolls more shields than the attacking figure rolls skulls, the attacking figure receives one wound. Counter Strike does not affect Destructible Objects.
design_note: At 15+ the smash becomes an occasional bonus rather than a plan, leaving a vanilla 5-life melee hero whose price must sit far below its twin.

name: Marro Spitterlings
ability_1_desc: After attacking with a Marro Spitterling, roll the 20-sided die. If you roll an 11 or higher, you may attack one additional time with that same Marro Spitterling. A Marro Spitterling may attack only one additional time each turn with Hive Frenzy.
ability_2_desc: When a Marro Spitterling is on a swamp water space, add 2 to its Defense Value. A Marro Spitterling does not have to stop its movement when entering a swamp water space.
design_note: A 50% chance of a second range 4 attack on each of four figures roughly acts as a half-strength double attack squad, which is hard to price against ordinary ranged commons.

name: Marro Spitterlings (variant)
ability_1_desc: After attacking with a Marro Spitterling, roll the 20-sided die. If you roll a 17 or higher, you may attack one additional time with that same Marro Spitterling. A Marro Spitterling may attack only one additional time each turn with Hive Frenzy.
ability_2_desc: When a Marro Spitterling is on a swamp water space, add 2 to its Defense Value. A Marro Spitterling does not have to stop its movement when entering a swamp water space.
design_note: With only a 20% frenzy chance the squad is close to a bare attack 2 defense 2 ranged common, so the pair tests how steeply extra-attack odds should be discounted.

name: Stormlance Vanguard
ability_1_desc: Before attacking with a Stormlance Vanguard who moved at least 4 spaces this turn, roll the 20-sided die. If you roll an 11 or higher, add 2 dice to that figure's attack for its normal attack this turn. Roll the 20-sided die separately for each Stormlance Vanguard figure taking a normal attack this turn.
ability_2_desc: When counting spaces for a Stormlance Vanguard's movement, ignore elevations. A Stormlance Vanguard may fly over water without stopping, pass over figures without becoming engaged, and fly over obstacles such as ruins. When a Stormlance Vanguard starts to fly, if it is engaged, it will take any leaving engagement attacks.
design_note: Flying melee squad figures that each average about a 1-die attack bonus at 11+ blur the line between a 3-attack and a 4-attack unique squad.

name: Stormlance Vanguard (variant)
ability_1_desc: Before attacking with a Stormlance Vanguard who moved at least 4 spaces this turn, roll the 20-sided die. If you roll a 17 or higher, add 2 dice to that figure's attack for its normal attack this turn. Roll the 20-sided die separately for each Stormlance Vanguard figure taking a normal attack this turn.
ability_2_desc: When counting spaces for a Stormlance Vanguard's movement, ignore elevations. A Stormlance Vanguard may fly over water without stopping, pass over figures without becoming engaged, and fly over obstacles such as ruins. When a Stormlance Vanguard starts to fly, if it is engaged, it will take any leaving engagement attacks.
design_note: At 17+ the charge is a rare spike, so the card is priced mostly on flying move 6 melee bodies and must be cheap enough to show the threshold gap.

name: Halberdiers of Kinsguard
ability_1_desc: Range 1. Attack 2. Choose up to 2 figures adjacent to the attacking Halberdier of Kinsguard. All chosen figures are affected by Halberd Sweep Special Attack. Roll 2 attack dice once for all affected figures. Each affected figure rolls defense dice separately.
ability_2_desc: When a Halberdier of Kinsguard is attacked with a normal attack by an adjacent Large or Huge figure, that Halberdier adds 2 to its Defense Value.
ability_3_desc: When a Halberdier of Kinsguard is attacked, add 1 to its Defense Value if it is adjacent to at least one other Halberdier of Kinsguard you control.
design_note: A cheap-looking melee common squad whose sweep attack, anti-big bonus, and formation defense all compound only when the figures are allowed to hold ground.

name: Halberdiers of Kinsguard (variant)
ability_1_desc: Range 1. Attack 2. Choose up to 2 figures adjacent to the attacking Halberdier of Kinsguard. All chosen figures are affected by Halberd Sweep Special Attack. Roll 2 attack dice once for all affected figures. Each affected figure rolls defense dice separately.
ability_2_desc: When a Halberdier of Kinsguard is attacked with a normal attack by an adjacent Large or Huge figure, that Halberdier adds 2 to its Defense Value.
ability_3_desc: When a Halberdier of Kinsguard is attacked, add 1 to its Defense Value if it is adjacent to at least one other Halberdier of Kinsguard you control.
ability_4_desc: When you take a turn with the Halberdiers of Kinsguard (variant), each Halberdier you control must move its full Move Value if possible, and every space it enters must be closer to the nearest opponent's figure than the space it just left. If a Halberdier cannot move closer to the nearest opponent's figure, that Halberdier does not move.
design_note: The forced advance guarantees the squad breaks its own adjacency formation and walks into enemy range, so the drawback erases much of the defensive value while leaving the offense intact.

name: Mekaneth Pulse Troopers
ability_1_desc: Before taking a turn with the Mekaneth Pulse Troopers, you may first take a turn with any Unique Soulborg Hero you control.
ability_2_desc: When a Mekaneth Pulse Trooper attacks a figure that is at least 4 spaces away, that Trooper rolls 1 additional attack die.
ability_3_desc: When a Mekaneth Pulse Trooper you control attacks a figure that is in the line of sight of another Mekaneth Pulse Trooper you control, the defending figure rolls 1 fewer defense die.
design_note: Range 6 with attack 3 plus two stacking accuracy powers and hero bonding puts this near the top of the ranged-squad band, making the twin's lost bonding hard to subtract cleanly.

name: Mekaneth Pulse Troopers (variant)
ability_1_desc: Before taking a turn with the Mekaneth Pulse Troopers, you may first take a turn with any Unique Soulborg Hero you control.
ability_2_desc: When a Mekaneth Pulse Trooper attacks a figure that is at least 4 spaces away, that Trooper rolls 1 additional attack die.
ability_3_desc: When a Mekaneth Pulse Trooper you control attacks a figure that is in the line of sight of another Mekaneth Pulse Trooper you control, the defending figure rolls 1 fewer defense die.
ability_4_desc: The Mekaneth Pulse Troopers (variant) cannot be bonded with. No bonding power on any Army Card, including their own Soulborg Command Bonding, may be used to take a turn with the Mekaneth Pulse Troopers (variant), and they may not be used to take a turn with any other Army Card.
design_note: The drawback leaves a dead printed bonding power on the card, so its cost must reflect pure order-marker efficiency loss rather than any stat change.

name: Blightfang Broodlings
ability_1_desc: When a Blightfang Broodling attacks an adjacent figure, it rolls 1 additional attack die for each other Blightfang Broodling you control who is also adjacent to the defending figure, up to a maximum of 2 additional attack dice.
ability_2_desc: Blightfang Broodlings do not have to stop their movement when entering water spaces, and may move through spaces occupied by other Marro figures you control without becoming engaged.
ability_3_desc: After taking a turn with the Blightfang Broodlings, you may roll the 20-sided die. If you roll a 16 or higher, you may immediately take a turn with one other Common Marro Squad you control.
design_note: Fragile attack-3 swarmers whose damage output swings wildly with adjacency and whose 25% extra-turn power is worth far more in a mass-Marro army than alone.

name: Blightfang Broodlings (variant)
ability_1_desc: When a Blightfang Broodling attacks an adjacent figure, it rolls 1 additional attack die for each other Blightfang Broodling you control who is also adjacent to the defending figure, up to a maximum of 2 additional attack dice.
ability_2_desc: Blightfang Broodlings do not have to stop their movement when entering water spaces, and may move through spaces occupied by other Marro figures you control without becoming engaged.
ability_3_desc: After taking a turn with the Blightfang Broodlings, you may roll the 20-sided die. If you roll a 16 or higher, you may immediately take a turn with one other Common Marro Squad you control.
ability_4_desc: After a Blightfang Broodling attacks, roll the 20-sided die. If you roll a 1-5, that Blightfang Broodling receives 1 wound. Roll separately for each Blightfang Broodling that attacks.
design_note: A 25% self-destruct chance on 1-life figures is close to losing a quarter of the squad every full turn, which is a steeper penalty than it looks on the card.

name: Shieldbearers of Grimhold Deep
ability_1_desc: Before taking a turn with the Shieldbearers of Grimhold Deep, you may first take a turn with any Warlord or Dwarf Hero you control who follows Einar.
ability_2_desc: When a Shieldbearer of Grimhold Deep is attacked with a normal attack, add 1 to its Defense Value for each other Shieldbearer of Grimhold Deep you control adjacent to it, up to a maximum of 2.
ability_3_desc: A Shieldbearer of Grimhold Deep never rolls fewer than 2 defense dice, no matter how many dice any special power or glyph would remove.
design_note: Defense 4 that can reach 6 in formation makes a low-attack squad nearly unkillable by small arms, so its price rides almost entirely on the bonding and the wall staying intact.

name: Shieldbearers of Grimhold Deep (variant)
ability_1_desc: Before taking a turn with the Shieldbearers of Grimhold Deep, you may first take a turn with any Warlord or Dwarf Hero you control who follows Einar.
ability_2_desc: When a Shieldbearer of Grimhold Deep is attacked with a normal attack, add 1 to its Defense Value for each other Shieldbearer of Grimhold Deep you control adjacent to it, up to a maximum of 2.
ability_3_desc: A Shieldbearer of Grimhold Deep never rolls fewer than 2 defense dice, no matter how many dice any special power or glyph would remove.
ability_4_desc: The Shieldbearers of Grimhold Deep (variant) cannot be bonded with. Ignore their Einar Warlord Bonding, and no other Army Card's bonding power may be used to take a turn with the Shieldbearers of Grimhold Deep (variant). You may only take a turn with this card by revealing an Order Marker on it.
design_note: With Move 4, no bonding, and only Attack 2, the variant must spend its own Order Markers just to crawl into contact, which taxes the whole army's action economy rather than the squad's own dice.

name: Verdant Hollow Longbows
ability_1_desc: When rolling defense dice for a Verdant Hollow Longbow you control that is adjacent to an Evergreen Tree, Brush, or Jungle Piece, add 1 defense die.
ability_2_desc: If a Verdant Hollow Longbow you control does not move before attacking on its turn, add 1 die to that figure's normal attack.
design_note: Range 6 attack 3 is already premium for a common squad, and Steady Aim converts stationary turns into attack 4, so the card's value swings heavily on whether the map rewards holding a firing line.

name: Verdant Hollow Longbows (variant)
ability_1_desc: When rolling defense dice for a Verdant Hollow Longbow (variant) you control that is adjacent to an Evergreen Tree, Brush, or Jungle Piece, add 1 defense die.
ability_2_desc: If a Verdant Hollow Longbow (variant) you control does not move before attacking on its turn, add 1 die to that figure's normal attack.
ability_3_desc: When you reveal an Order Marker on this Army Card, each Verdant Hollow Longbow (variant) you control that is not engaged must move, and must end its movement on a space closer to the nearest opponent's figure than the space it started on, if possible. Count spaces to determine the nearest opponent's figure; if two or more are equally near, you may choose which one to move toward.
ability_4_desc: A Verdant Hollow Longbow (variant) that was required to move by Hollow Bloodlust cannot use Steady Aim this turn.
design_note: Forced advance guts a range 6 squad's entire advantage by dragging it into melee and switching off its bonus attack die, but figures already engaged are exempt, which makes the penalty inconsistent and hard to price.

name: Skyclaw Talonguard
ability_1_desc: When counting spaces for a Skyclaw Talonguard's movement, ignore elevations. A Skyclaw Talonguard may fly over water without stopping, pass over figures without becoming engaged, and fly over obstacles such as ruins. When a Skyclaw Talonguard starts to fly, if it is engaged it will take any leaving engagement attacks.
ability_2_desc: If a Skyclaw Talonguard you control moves at least 4 spaces before attacking, and the space it attacks from is at least 2 levels higher than the space of the defending figure, add 1 die to that attack.
ability_3_desc: When rolling defense dice for a Skyclaw Talonguard you control that is within 3 clear sight spaces of a Kyrie Hero you control who follows Einar, add 1 defense die.
design_note: A three-figure unique squad with flight, a conditional attack 4 dive, and a defense aura that only turns on alongside Einar Kyrie heroes is worth far more in its home army than alone.

name: Skyclaw Talonguard (variant)
ability_1_desc: When counting spaces for a Skyclaw Talonguard (variant)'s movement, ignore elevations. A Skyclaw Talonguard (variant) may fly over water without stopping, pass over figures without becoming engaged, and fly over obstacles such as ruins. When a Skyclaw Talonguard (variant) starts to fly, if it is engaged it will take any leaving engagement attacks.
ability_2_desc: If a Skyclaw Talonguard (variant) you control moves at least 4 spaces before attacking, and the space it attacks from is at least 2 levels higher than the space of the defending figure, add 1 die to that attack.
ability_3_desc: When rolling defense dice for a Skyclaw Talonguard (variant) you control that is within 3 clear sight spaces of a Kyrie Hero you control who follows Einar, add 1 defense die.
ability_4_desc: Skyclaw Talonguard (variant) cannot be bonded with. Ignore all special powers on other Army Cards that would allow you to take a turn with Skyclaw Talonguard (variant) or allow you to move Skyclaw Talonguard (variant). You may take a turn with Skyclaw Talonguard (variant) only by revealing an Order Marker on this Army Card.
design_note: The no-bonding clause strips Kyrie hero synergy that the card's own defense aura still encourages, while Lone Vigil pays the squad to operate away from that aura, creating two powers that pull the price in opposite directions.

name: Gorehide Ripperkin
ability_1_desc: When a Gorehide Ripperkin attacks a figure with at least 1 Wound Marker on its Army Card, add 1 die to its attack.
ability_2_desc: A Gorehide Ripperkin adjacent to a friendly Orc Hero adds 1 die to its defense.
ability_3_desc: After a Gorehide Ripperkin you control destroys an enemy figure with a normal attack, you may move that Gorehide Ripperkin up to 2 spaces. It is never attacked when leaving an engagement with Scavenge Charge.
design_note: Both of its bonuses are conditional on friendly Orc Heroes and wounded targets, so its real value swings wildly between a solo filler squad and a warlord-supported hammer.

name: Gorehide Ripperkin (variant)
ability_1_desc: When a Gorehide Ripperkin attacks a figure with at least 1 Wound Marker on its Army Card, add 1 die to its attack.
ability_2_desc: A Gorehide Ripperkin adjacent to a friendly Orc Hero adds 1 die to its defense.
ability_3_desc: After a Gorehide Ripperkin you control destroys an enemy figure with a normal attack, you may move that Gorehide Ripperkin up to 2 spaces. It is never attacked when leaving an engagement with Scavenge Charge.
ability_4_desc: You may never use a bonding power, or any other power on another Army Card that allows you to take a turn with or move figures, to take a turn with, move, or attack with Gorehide Ripperkin. Gorehide Ripperkin may only be activated by revealing an Order Marker on this Army Card.
design_note: Losing all external bonding and activation synergy costs a cheap Orc swarm most of its army-building upside while leaving its raw stats untouched.

name: Ohm-Class Arc Wardens
ability_1_desc: Range 6. Attack 2. Choose a figure to attack. All figures adjacent to the defending figure are also affected by Arc Chain Special Attack. Roll attack dice once for all affected figures. Each affected figure rolls defense dice separately.
ability_2_desc: When an Arc Warden attacks a figure that is adjacent to another friendly Soulborg, add 1 die to its attack.
ability_3_desc: Arc Wardens are never affected by special attacks or powers that would move them, and they do not roll defense dice against Arc Chain Special Attack.
design_note: A three-figure unique squad with Range 6, Attack 3, and a splash special attack sits right at the top of the ranged-squad band, so every point of its splash potential matters.

name: Ohm-Class Arc Wardens (variant)
ability_1_desc: Range 6. Attack 2. Choose a figure to attack. All figures adjacent to the defending figure are also affected by Arc Chain Special Attack. Roll attack dice once for all affected figures. Each affected figure rolls defense dice separately.
ability_2_desc: When an Arc Warden attacks a figure that is adjacent to another friendly Soulborg, add 1 die to its attack.
ability_3_desc: Arc Wardens are never affected by special attacks or powers that would move them, and they do not roll defense dice against Arc Chain Special Attack.
ability_4_desc: After an Arc Warden you control attacks with a normal attack or with Arc Chain Special Attack, roll the 20-sided die. If you roll a 1, 2, 3, 4, or 5, that Arc Warden receives 1 wound. Defense dice are not rolled against this wound.
design_note: Because squad figures have only 1 life, a 25% self-destruct chance on every attack erases roughly a quarter of the card's total output and shortens its lifespan unpredictably.

name: Naginata Ashigaru of Kaburagi
ability_1_desc: When attacking, a Naginata Ashigaru may attack an enemy figure exactly 2 spaces away, as long as it has clear line of sight to that figure and that figure's base is no more than 4 levels above or below it. When attacking with Naginata Reach, subtract 1 from that Naginata Ashigaru's Attack Value.
ability_2_desc: When rolling defense dice against a normal attack, a Naginata Ashigaru adds 1 die to its defense if it is adjacent to at least 2 other Naginata Ashigaru you control.
design_note: A melee squad that can strike from 2 spaces away without becoming engaged blurs the line between melee and ranged pricing, especially paired with a formation defense bonus that rewards clumping.

name: Naginata Ashigaru of Kaburagi (variant)
ability_1_desc: When attacking, a Naginata Ashigaru may attack an enemy figure exactly 2 spaces away, as long as it has clear line of sight to that figure and that figure's base is no more than 4 levels above or below it. When attacking with Naginata Reach, subtract 1 from that Naginata Ashigaru's Attack Value.
ability_2_desc: When rolling defense dice against a normal attack, a Naginata Ashigaru adds 1 die to its defense if it is adjacent to at least 2 other Naginata Ashigaru you control.
ability_3_desc: Whenever you move a Naginata Ashigaru, it must end its movement closer to the nearest enemy figure than it was at the start of that movement, if possible. To determine the nearest enemy figure, count the fewest number of spaces to each enemy figure, ignoring elevation.
design_note: Forced advancement hurts far less on a melee squad that wants engagement, but it also scatters the figures out of Ashigaru Formation range, making the true discount small and easy to misjudge.

name: Glimmerwisp Sprites
ability_1_desc: When an opponent's figure adjacent to one or more Glimmerwisp Sprites you control attacks with a normal attack, it subtracts 1 from its Attack Value.
ability_2_desc: When counting spaces for a Glimmerwisp Sprite's movement, ignore elevations. A Glimmerwisp Sprite may fly over water without stopping, pass over figures without becoming engaged, and fly over obstacles such as ruins. When a Glimmerwisp Sprite starts to fly, if it is engaged it will take any leaving engagement attacks.
ability_3_desc: At the end of each round, roll the 20-sided die once for each Glimmerwisp Sprite you control on the battlefield. If you roll a 3 or lower for that figure, destroy it. Destroyed Glimmerwisp Sprites cannot be returned to the battlefield by any special power or glyph.
design_note: The squad slowly deletes itself for free on a 15% per-figure per-round roll, so its value depends entirely on how many rounds the buyer expects the game to last.

name: Glimmerwisp Sprites (variant)
ability_1_desc: When an opponent's figure adjacent to one or more Glimmerwisp Sprites you control attacks with a normal attack, it subtracts 1 from its Attack Value.
ability_2_desc: When counting spaces for a Glimmerwisp Sprite's movement, ignore elevations. A Glimmerwisp Sprite may fly over water without stopping, pass over figures without becoming engaged, and fly over obstacles such as ruins. When a Glimmerwisp Sprite starts to fly, if it is engaged it will take any leaving engagement attacks.
design_note: Removing the self-destruct turns a fragile gimmick into a durable flying debuff squad, and the pricing gap between the twins is easy to over- or under-shoot.

name: Grukk Skullmad
ability_1_desc: If Grukk Skullmad destroys one or more figures with a normal attack during his turn, he may immediately attack one additional time with a normal attack. Grukk may not attack more than three times in a single turn with Frenzied Onslaught.
ability_2_desc: At the start of Grukk Skullmad's turn, if there is any figure within 6 clear sight spaces of Grukk, he must move by the shortest available route to engage the figure nearest to him, friendly or opposing, and if he is engaged with that figure after moving he must attack it with his normal attack. You may not choose any other target for Grukk's normal attack while that figure is engaged with him.
ability_3_desc: Grukk Skullmad is never attacked when leaving an engagement.
design_note: Forced targeting that can compel a 5-die attack into your own squads is crippling in mixed armies but nearly harmless in a solo-melee build, making the discount highly army-dependent.

name: Grukk Skullmad (variant)
ability_1_desc: If Grukk Skullmad destroys one or more figures with a normal attack during his turn, he may immediately attack one additional time with a normal attack. Grukk may not attack more than three times in a single turn with Frenzied Onslaught.
ability_2_desc: Grukk Skullmad is never attacked when leaving an engagement.
design_note: Free target choice plus chain attacks makes this an elite squad-shredding melee hero, and its price must reflect that Frenzied Onslaught is now fully reliable.

name: Ashpyre Firecaller
ability_1_desc: Range 1. Attack 3. Firestorm Special Attack affects all figures adjacent to the Ashpyre Firecaller, friendly and opposing. Roll 3 attack dice once for all affected figures. Each affected figure rolls defense dice separately.
ability_2_desc: Each time an Ashpyre Firecaller uses Firestorm Special Attack, after all defense dice have been rolled, that Ashpyre Firecaller receives one wound.
ability_3_desc: When counting spaces for an Ashpyre Firecaller's movement, ignore elevations. An Ashpyre Firecaller may fly over water without stopping, pass over figures without becoming engaged, and fly over obstacles such as ruins. When an Ashpyre Firecaller starts to fly, if it is engaged it will take any leaving engagement attacks.
design_note: A 3-life common hero that wounds itself every time it uses its best power can only fire twice, so the drawback effectively caps its lifetime output rather than merely taxing it.

name: Ashpyre Firecaller (variant)
ability_1_desc: Range 1. Attack 3. Firestorm Special Attack affects all figures adjacent to the Ashpyre Firecaller, friendly and opposing. Roll 3 attack dice once for all affected figures. Each affected figure rolls defense dike separately.
ability_2_desc: When counting spaces for an Ashpyre Firecaller's movement, ignore elevations. An Ashpyre Firecaller may fly over water without stopping, pass over figures without becoming engaged, and fly over obstacles such as ruins. When an Ashpyre Firecaller starts to fly, if it is engaged it will take any leaving engagement attacks.
design_note: Unlimited repeatable area attacks on a cheap flying common hero that can be fielded in multiples risks being far more than a small discount away from its wounded twin.

name: Ithkarr Emberhusk
ability_1_desc: Range 6. Attack 3. When counting spaces for Ithkarr Emberhusk's Cinder Lance Special Attack, ignore all figures. After attacking with Cinder Lance Special Attack, you may choose one figure adjacent to the defending figure and roll 1 attack die against that figure. If you roll a skull, the chosen figure receives 1 wound. Figures attacked in this way do not roll defense dice.
ability_2_desc: When rolling defense dice for Ithkarr Emberhusk against a normal attack from an adjacent figure, add 1 automatic shield to the defense roll.
ability_3_desc: At the end of each round, roll the 20-sided die. If you roll a 1-5, destroy Ithkarr Emberhusk.
design_note: A 25% chance of self-destruction at the end of every round means the card is likely gone by round three or four, so the discount must account for lost order markers as well as lost stats.

name: Ithkarr Emberhusk (variant)
ability_1_desc: Range 6. Attack 3. When counting spaces for Ithkarr Emberhusk's Cinder Lance Special Attack, ignore all figures. After attacking with Cinder Lance Special Attack, you may choose one figure adjacent to the defending figure and roll 1 attack die against that figure. If you roll a skull, the chosen figure receives 1 wound. Figures attacked in this way do not roll defense dice.
ability_2_desc: When rolling defense dice for Ithkarr Emberhusk against a normal attack from an adjacent figure, add 1 automatic shield to the defense roll.
design_note: Without the self-destruct clause this becomes a reliable range 6 attack 4 hero with splash damage and a defensive boost, and pricing must weigh how much of his old cost was pure risk.

name: Grinlok Ripperhounds
ability_1_desc: When attacking with a Grinlok Ripperhound, roll 1 additional attack die for each other Grinlok Ripperhound you control adjacent to the defending figure.
ability_2_desc: Grinlok Ripperhounds are never attacked when leaving an engagement.
ability_3_desc: When attacking with a Grinlok Ripperhound, you must choose as the defending figure the opponent's figure nearest to that Grinlok Ripperhound, counting the minimum number of spaces. If two or more of an opponent's figures are equally near, you may choose which one to attack.
design_note: Forced targeting of the nearest enemy actively fights against Pack Charge, since the squad cannot concentrate its attacks on one figure unless the terrain cooperates.

name: Grinlok Ripperhounds (variant)
ability_1_desc: When attacking with a Grinlok Ripperhound, roll 1 additional attack die for each other Grinlok Ripperhound you control adjacent to the defending figure.
ability_2_desc: Grinlok Ripperhounds are never attacked when leaving an engagement.
design_note: Free targeting turns a move 7 disengaging swarm into a focus-fire machine that can throw five or six attack dice at a single hero, which is worth far more than the die-roll math suggests.

name: Tidewrack Marauders
ability_1_desc: After attacking a non-adjacent figure with a Tidewrack Marauder, if at least 1 skull was rolled, you may place the defending figure on any empty space adjacent to that Tidewrack Marauder that is not more than 3 levels above or below that Marauder. Huge figures cannot be moved by Harpoon Line.
ability_2_desc: Tidewrack Marauders may move through water spaces without stopping and never take leaving engagement attacks when leaving a water space.
ability_3_desc: At the start of each round, after Order Markers have been placed, roll the 20-sided die. If you roll a 1-5, your opponent takes control of this Army Card for the round. Your opponent reveals Order Markers on this card and takes turns with the Tidewrack Marauders as if they were figures they control. At the end of the round, you regain control of this Army Card.
design_note: A 25% per-round chance that the opponent gets your order markers and your ranged attacks is a swing far worse than simply losing the turns, so the drawback is worth more than the squad's offense.

name: Tidewrack Marauders (variant)
ability_1_desc: After attacking a non-adjacent figure with a Tidewrack Marauder, if at least 1 skull was rolled, you may place the defending figure on any empty space adjacent to that Tidewrack Marauder that is not more than 3 levels above or below that Marauder. Huge figures cannot be moved by Harpoon Line.
ability_2_desc: Tidewrack Marauders may move through water spaces without stopping and never take leaving engagement attacks when leaving a water space.
design_note: Range 5 attack 3 on three unique figures plus free forced movement is already premium squad territory, so the clean version has to be priced near the top of the ranged-squad band.

name: Vaelith Stormtalon
ability_1_desc: Range 1. Attack 4. Vaelith Stormtalon may attack with Talon Dive Special Attack only if she moved at least 4 spaces this turn and is at least 3 levels above the defending figure. Figures attacked by Talon Dive Special Attack roll 1 fewer defense die.
ability_2_desc: When counting spaces for Vaelith Stormtalon's movement, ignore elevations. She may fly over water without stopping, pass over figures without becoming engaged, and fly over obstacles such as ruins. When Vaelith Stormtalon starts to fly, if she is engaged, she will take any leaving engagement attacks.
ability_3_desc: After revealing an Order Marker on Vaelith Stormtalon and before taking a turn with her, your opponent chooses one figure they control within 10 clear sight spaces of Vaelith Stormtalon. This turn, Vaelith Stormtalon must move as close as possible to the chosen figure, and she may attack only the chosen figure.
design_note: The opponent chooses her target every turn, which both nullifies her dive requirements and lets them bait her into their strongest defenders, gutting an otherwise elite flier.

name: Vaelith Stormtalon (variant)
ability_1_desc: Range 1. Attack 4. Vaelith Stormtalon may attack with Talon Dive Special Attack only if she moved at least 4 spaces this turn and is at least 3 levels above the defending figure. Figures attacked by Talon Dive Special Attack roll 1 fewer defense die.
ability_2_desc: When counting spaces for Vaelith Stormtalon's movement, ignore elevations. She may fly over water without stopping, pass over figures without becoming engaged, and fly over obstacles such as ruins. When Vaelith Stormtalon starts to fly, if she is engaged, she will take any leaving engagement attacks.
design_note: With target selection back in the owner's hands, her dive becomes a reliable assassination tool on high terrain maps, but its elevation requirement makes the value swing map-dependent.

name: Malvek the Hollow
ability_1_desc: Range 1. Attack 3. If the defending figure receives one or more wounds from Soul Drain Special Attack, you may remove one Wound Marker from Malvek the Hollow's Army Card.
ability_2_desc: Malvek the Hollow can move through all figures and never takes leaving engagement attacks.
ability_3_desc: At the end of each round, roll the 20-sided die. If you roll a 5 or lower, the player to your left gains control of Malvek the Hollow. That player places order markers on and takes turns with Malvek the Hollow until the end of the next round, at which time you gain control of Malvek the Hollow again.
design_note: A 25%-per-round chance of handing a Life 4, Attack 4 self-healing hero to an opponent is a swingy, hard-to-quantify tempo and information loss.

name: Malvek the Hollow (variant)
ability_1_desc: Range 1. Attack 3. If the defending figure receives one or more wounds from Soul Drain Special Attack, you may remove one Wound Marker from Malvek the Hollow's Army Card.
ability_2_desc: Malvek the Hollow can move through all figures and never takes leaving engagement attacks.
design_note: With no control-loss clause, this becomes a clean self-sustaining skirmisher whose price must sit above its twin by exactly the value of never losing him.

name: Ghorumel the Unraveling
ability_1_desc: Instead of moving normally with Ghorumel the Unraveling, you may place him on any empty land space within 7 spaces of his current location. Ghorumel the Unraveling may Rift Step even if he is engaged, and he never takes leaving engagement attacks when he Rift Steps.
ability_2_desc: If Ghorumel the Unraveling did not move on his turn, he may attack one additional time. He cannot attack the same figure more than once per turn with Tearing Claws.
ability_3_desc: At the end of each round, roll the 20-sided die. If you roll a 3 or lower, Ghorumel the Unraveling is immediately destroyed.
design_note: A flat 15% chance each round of simply losing a premium beefy attacker with no wounds dealt to him is an all-or-nothing risk that resists straight expected-damage math.

name: Ghorumel the Unraveling (variant)
ability_1_desc: Instead of moving normally with Ghorumel the Unraveling, you may place him on any empty land space within 7 spaces of his current location. Ghorumel the Unraveling may Rift Step even if he is engaged, and he never takes leaving engagement attacks when he Rift Steps.
ability_2_desc: If Ghorumel the Unraveling did not move on his turn, he may attack one additional time. He cannot attack the same figure more than once per turn with Tearing Claws.
design_note: Without the self-destruct roll this is a durable teleporting double-attacker, so pricing hinges on how many rounds a game is expected to last.
